jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Agentic Commerce
jobs.description_html:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London or Lisbon

About the Department

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.

About the Team

We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.

Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We are building tools that help make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.

Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We’re looking for someone excited to deliver products so domain owners can control this experience, while identifying the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across Agentic Commerce.

You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power machine-to-machine payments and monetization, such as our Monetization Gateway. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around payment rails and cryptographic auth, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.

At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

What you'll do

  • Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across high-throughput payment pipelines, agent authentication, and web-scale commerce architecture.
  • Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
  • Lead the development of agentic payment systems leveraging emerging open standards (x402, Web Bot Auth, ACP, UCP) to enable low-latency, machine-to-machine micropayments.
  • Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.
  • Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
  • Bridge mainstream and decentralized tech, interfacing with blockchain teams while keeping execution focused on mainstream, high-throughput web and fiat commerce rails.
  • Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
  • Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.
  • Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

Responsibilities

We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:

  • You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.
  • You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in distributed systems or payment platforms, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.
  • You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas (like digital wallets, payment protocols, and web authorization) and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.
  • You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.
  • You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.
  • You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, low-latency transaction processing, API design, web security, or adjacent areas.
  • Experience building or operating products involving traditional payment rails, digital wallets, or open authorization/authentication standards (e.g., OAuth, WebAuthn, Web Bot Auth).
  • Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.
  • Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with emerging agentic/machine-to-machine payment protocols (x402, AP2, ACP, UCP).
  • Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.
  • Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.
  • Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.
  • Previous experience working in payments and on payments technology

Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €74,000 - €93,000

Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits
Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.

That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. 

Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.

As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.

This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.

Responsibilities

  • Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.
  • Build for the whole Internet by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.
  • Make resilience a product principle. Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.
  • Drive an ACME-first customer experience that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.
  • Partner closely with engineering on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.
  • Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.
  • Own go-to-market strategy including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.
  • Represent the customer and the ecosystem in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.
  • Work across Cloudflare product teams including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.
  • Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • 10+ years of product management experience building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.
  • Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.
  • Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.
  • Strong business judgment with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.
  • Technical fluency with engineering teams and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.
  • Strong written communication for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.
  • Comfort with high-consequence work. A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.
  • Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.
  • Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.
  • Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.
  • Experience launching new businesses or zero-to-one products inside a larger platform company.
  • Familiarity with certificate automation challenges created by 90-day and shorter certificate lifetimes.
  • Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility, Merkle Tree Certificates, or customer migration planning for cryptographic transitions.
  • Prior participation in WebPKI, IETF, browser trust, transparency, or security standards communities.

  • Capacity Planning & Forecasting: Partner with the customer to understand future demand, forecast capacity needs, and proactively identify constraints.

  • Feedback Loop & Product Influence: Surface real-world operational issues and platform opportunities with Cloudflare's Infrastructure, Hardware, and Product teams to inform future roadmaps.

  • On-Site Presence: Spend time regularly on-site at customer offices to foster close communication and partnership with their engineering teams.

About the team

The Data Intelligence & Analytics organization builds the core data platform and internal products that power decision-making across the company. We design and operate large-scale data systems, own the company’s data lake, ingestion infrastructure, and platform tooling, and develop end-to-end applications that transform complex datasets into fast, reliable, business-critical products used daily by go-to-market, product, and engineering teams. Our work sits at the intersection of data platforms, distributed systems, and product development, giving engineers the opportunity to own meaningful problems across the stack and build systems that truly run the business.

About the role

We are looking for a visionary and hands-on Lead Machine Learning Engineer to join our Austin team. In this role, you will be the principal architect behind the next generation of our unified AI/ML platform, designing and building the infrastructure that powers everything from traditional predictive models to generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and autonomous agent frameworks.

You will own the end-to-end technical strategy, blueprint, and execution of scalable backend services and data pipelines that support AI-driven applications across go-to-market, engineering, and product teams. Because our products are initiated and owned entirely within the team, you will drive the vision from initial requirements and system design to global deployment, optimization, and long-term evolutionary ownership.

What you'll do

  • Architect and evolve a highly scalable, multi-tenant AI/ML platform that seamlessly unifies traditional ML (classification, regression, forecasting) and Generative AI/LLM orchestration.
  • Design and implement robust production-grade AI Agents and Advanced Chatbots. Build reliable execution environments for Multi-Agent Systems, including state management, long-term memory architectures, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integrations.
  • Build high-throughput, low-latency application backends and orchestration layers. Partner closely with data, platform, and full-stack engineers to ensure seamless feature delivery and reliable production operations.
  • Act as a technical anchor for the Data Science team – enforcing rigorous engineering standards, leading design and security reviews, evaluating build-vs-buy decisions, and mapping business requirements to robust technical designs.
  • Evaluate trade-offs and drive adoption of modern AI infrastructure tools, optimized embedding pipelines, vector databases, and serverless compute paradigms (such as Workers AI).\

Must-Have Skills

  • Extensive experience as a Senior or Lead ML Engineer, with a proven track record of architecting and operating production-grade ML platforms, services  and distributed backends.
  • Strong competency in Traditional ML lifecycles (feature stores, training pipelines, model monitoring) alongside deep experience in Generative AI patterns (RAG pipelines, context engineering, fine-tuning, guardrailing, and agentic AI systems).
  • Mastery of Python and robust experience with modern backend ecosystems. Familiarity with (or willingness to collaborate on) full-stack technologies like React and TypeScript is highly valued.
  • A builder's mindset. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, shaping your own technical roadmap, adapt as needed and taking extreme ownership of system reliability, costs, and model performance.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Technical Leadership & Systems Architecture

  • 3+ years of dedicated ML Engineering experience within a large-scale, enterprise environment (handling petabyte-scale data and working across globally distributed teams).
  • Proven ability to architect, scale, and secure reliable, highly observable distributed systems, with a track record of leveling up platform foundations.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, leading by example through high-quality code and rigorous design reviews, and fostering a culture of technical excellence.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a demonstrated ability to independently drive complex projects through ambiguous spaces and collaborate cross-functionally with data engineers, full-stack teams, and analysts.

AI, LLMOps & Agentic Engineering

  • Hands-on proficiency in building production-grade GenAI applications and multi-agent systems using advanced LLM frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, or Autogen. Deep understanding of agent harness primitives, state management, memory architectures, and tool-calling loop mechanics.
  • Experience establishing LLMOps foundations, including automated prompt tracking, LLM evaluation pipelines (e.g., Ragas, TruLens), vector database optimization, context/token management, and real-time guardrailing/moderation layers.
  • Deep experience in scientific computing using Python (Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) and deploying traditional systems for end-to-end training, batch/real-time inference, and model observability.

  • Provide and demand accountability. You are responsible for the delivery of your commitments and you will hold your peers and subordinates accountable for theirs.

Email remains the most trusted, yet most targeted, communication channel in the enterprise. At Cloudflare, we have a proven email security solution which is trusted by Fortune 500 and Global 2000 organizations. We are seeking an autonomous, determined, and pragmatic individual who possesses strong conviction, humility, and a decisive bias toward action.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for defining how some of the world's most sophisticated organizations protect their communication, leading the industry's shift away from legacy "boxes" toward an AI-first, cloud-native, and identity-aware security posture.

  • Talk to Customers. Build trust with engineering and sales by rigorously documenting first-hand experiences with internal and external customers. 
  • Drive new business. Act as the strategic engine for growth, building the features and competitive differentiators needed to displace legacy incumbents and win the hearts and minds of Global 2000 CISOs.
  • Evangelize the Platform. Use the product daily and serve as a technical and strategic leader, representing the Email Security vision to internal stakeholders, the sales field, and the broader security community.

  • 7+ years of experience as product manager, with a proven track record of owning and scaling complex enterprise security products in a high-growth environment.
  • Be customer obsessed. At Cloudflare, we serve the needs of customers large and small, and our product managers need to be comfortable understanding how to design for enterprises without compromising the experience for individuals and small businesses. 
  • Write Persuasively. The best product managers at Cloudflare are exceptional storytellers. They distill complex ideas into simple ones by using context, empathy, transparency, and evidence. 
  • Build with conviction. Demonstrated experience leading with conviction to build products designed to win in a highly competitive market, with a focus on feature differentiation and displacement strategy.
  • Maintain domain knowledge. Comfortable navigating architectural trade-offs with senior engineers regarding mail flow (M365/Google Workspace), cloud infrastructure, and API performance.
  • Have high ownership. Comfortable being accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from high-fidelity PRDs to collaborating with cross-functional teams for global launches.

  • Good design sense. You’re comfortable collaborating with design engineers to translate the requirements into lo-fi prototypes.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to own data center delivery and the sourcing work that gets each site ready to operate. You'll take projects from vendor selection and contract negotiation through construction, infrastructure deployment, commissioning, and handover to operations.

This role combines technical program management with hands-on commercial execution. You'll work with engineering, construction, procurement, and operations teams to ensure facilities, equipment, and site services are ready when they're needed, with clear accountability for schedule, cost, and quality.

What you'll do

Deliver data centers

  • Represent Cloudflare across new builds and expansions, managing data center providers, general contractors, design consultants, commissioning agents, and compute integration partners.
  • Coordinate mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) installation, white space fit-out, rack-level power, structured cabling, equipment staging and validation, and commissioning through operational acceptance.
  • Maintain a delivery schedule that connects construction milestones, equipment arrivals, service activation, and deployment dependencies. Resolve field issues and drive recovery plans when commitments slip.
  • Assess vendor and partner readiness before deployment, and coordinate handover with operations so acceptance criteria, documentation, and support responsibilities are clear.

Source site services and manage contracts

We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.

We build tools that make the new internet payable by giving our users the ability to monetize access to their content, data, services, products, and outcomes across the Internet, regardless of where they are hosted.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Agentic Commerce team to build the core systems, protocols, and customer-facing tools powering machine-to-machine payments, metering, and monetization.

You will work on cutting-edge standards, cryptographic authentication, and commerce controls that enable businesses to define pricing terms, authenticate agents, verify outcomes, and manage agent-generated revenue streams.

  • Build high-precision systems for usage metering, pricing definition, outcome verification, and value attribution tailored for agentic workflows.
  • Build secure protocols and capabilities for authenticating and authorizing buyers, sellers, and autonomous agents across host-agnostic endpoints.
  • Develop capabilities and APIs that give businesses granular visibility, telemetry, and control over agent-generated revenue, billing, and settlement.
  • Build resilient bridges between mainstream fiat commerce rails, digital wallets, and decentralized/cryptographic payment protocols for Internet-scale micropayments.
  • Write clean, secure, well-tested code, maintain strict accounting/financial precision, and advocate for high reliability, security, and low-latency performance.
  • Partner with software engineers, researchers, product managers, design engineers, and cross-Cloudflare stakeholders to take capabilities from concept to production.

  • Experience building and operating reliable, high-throughput, low-latency production services.

  • Hands-on experience or deep interest in payment systems, usage metering, billing engines, digital wallets, or machine-to-machine interaction protocols.
  • Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and ship solutions in a fast-moving, emerging technical domain.

About the Role

We're hiring the first Dashboard & Configuration Product Manager Cloudflare's Web Integrity & Trust product suite. More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our customers.Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the web. That vantage point lets us detect automated threats, fraud, and traffic manipulation at a scale and depth no one else can match. Turning that raw signal into something a human can understand, trust, and act on is one of the most interesting design problems in security today — and it's the problem you'll own.

Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment. “Is this traffic truthfully representing who they are?” and "Can we trust this traffic?" doesn't have a clean yes-or-no answer. Our objective is to minimize risk without ever having ground truth. Your job is to make that kind of reasoning legible and controllable to the people who rely on it, from the security analyst running an investigation to the marketing team trying to understand the performance of their most recent campaign.

This role spans the full arc of how customers work with our product suite, from navigation, configuration, exploring and investigating their traffic, to proving the value of what Cloudflare's network sees. Today those experiences live in disconnected places; a core part of this role is envisioning the coherent product they should become. This role will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line

This is a rare "0-to-1" seat: you'll help define the interaction model for a suite of product categories we are largely inventing, with room to shape not just how it looks but what it fundamentally is.

About the Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

About the Role

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive Strategic Supply Planning: Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.

  • Manage Material & Production Readiness: Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.

  • Guide Operational Tradeoffs: Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.

  • Translate Long-Term Strategy: Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.

  • Monitor Program Financials & Progress: Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.

  • Lead Supplier Relationships: Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.

  • Expand Resilient Manufacturing: Evaluate and recommend new L11 suppliers and build locations to strengthen geographic resiliency, capacity growth, and technical standards.

  • Support Commercial Operations: Validate supplier requisitions, purchase orders, and commercial agreements while supporting leadership approval workflows.

  • Partner on Global Supply Risk Mitigation: Collaborate with Capacity Planning, Procurement, and Hardware Sourcing to identify and mitigate rack integration risks involving capacity bottlenecks, logistics hurdles, tariffs, and regional concentration.

  • Partner on New Product Introductions (NPI): Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and rack integration teams to translate evolving hardware designs into operational preproduction and build readiness plans.

  • Support Supplier Quality: Analyze supplier-performance trends, coordinate escalations, and track cross-functional quality and engineering issues through resolution.

  • Operationalize ERP Workflows: Support adoption and stabilization of the team’s Oracle ERP processes, then identify improvements to planning, reporting, controls, and operational efficiency.

  • Deliver Executive Insights: Create clear forecasts, operational reporting, and risk assessments for leadership review.

  • Scale the Operating Model: Establish sustainable operational frameworks that expand production capacity while maximizing efficiency.

  • Broad professional experience in global supply chain management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a related field.

  • Proven track record coordinating supply and production programs across multi-site manufacturing environments and international regions.

  • Demonstrated skill in connecting demand forecasts, material readiness, supplier capacity, and manufacturing schedules.

  • Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs across engineering, procurement, finance, and external vendors.

  • Strong analytical skills with expertise in supply modeling, risk assessment, and operational reporting.

  • Demonstrated capability to manage supplier performance and lead business reviews at both operational and executive levels.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting strategic options and risks to leadership.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones.

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About the Role

We’re building a next-generation ambient AI platform for healthcare, helping clinicians focus on patient care by automatically capturing, understanding, and structuring clinical conversations in real time.

Our product supports clinicians across the full care workflow, from capturing patient conversations and reviewing AI-generated documentation to coordinating follow-up actions and completing work across mobile and web.

We’re hiring a Full-Stack Product Engineer to build these experiences from end to end. You’ll work across our mobile and web applications, backend services, APIs, and AI-powered workflows, partnering closely with product, design, clinical, and AI teams.

jobs.description_html:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About the Role

The Commure Ambient team is building the AI-native clinical operating layer for providers. Our AI prepares clinicians before the visit, documents the conversation during it, codes the encounter after, writes structured data back to the EHR, and supports nurses across the full shift. All so clinicians spend more time with patients and less on their screens.

We are looking for a PM who wants to own a product surface end to end and drive deep impact. You'll work with dedicated engineering, design, clinical, ops, and GTM partners, and be accountable for how the whole product succeeds.

What You'll Do

  • Set the strategy for a major product surface and drive it from vision through discovery, spec, launch, adoption, and iteration. What you ship this year shapes how care gets delivered across the country.

  • Work full stack across the whole product motion. Craft intuitive UIs clinicians actually want to use, set the bar on backend reliability and model quality, and shape the GTM strategy and operational playbooks that drive adoption across clinics and hospitals. You do this alongside dedicated engineering, design, clinical, ops, and GTM partners.

  • Sit shoulder to shoulder with providers. Spend real time onsite in clinics, hospitals, and on nursing floors. Watch how care actually gets delivered, feel the friction, and carry that back into every prioritization decision.

  • Build direct relationships with clinical and executive customers at some of the largest health systems in the country. Understand their world, ship into their environments, and partner with GTM to drive adoption and expansion.

  • Own the metrics that matter. Define the OKRs, use quantitative and qualitative signal to prioritize, and stay accountable to the outcomes.

  • Define what best-in-class AI-native healthcare software should feel like. The category is being invented right now, and the products that win will be the ones providers actually love to use.

  • Choose your path as the team grows. Build toward managing PMs if you want to become a people leader, or stay hands-on and take on increasingly broad and strategic product surfaces as an IC. Both tracks are real, and both are valued.

What You Have

We are hiring at both levels and calibrate scope to experience.

  • Senior PM: 3+ years of product management experience, with strong generalist fundamentals and a track record of owning products end to end.

  • Staff PM: A track record of setting strategy, driving complex product areas across multiple teams, and influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders.

Across both levels, we're looking for:

  • Familiarity with AI. You have used and reasoned about LLMs, agents, and evals. You keep up with the frontier and get excited about what's shipping this month, not last year.

  • Technical fluency to read documentation, understand APIs and integrations, and hold substantive conversations with engineers.

  • A structured approach to user research and a real track record of turning insight into shipped product.

  • Sharp written and verbal communication. You can write a PRD that aligns cross-functional teams across engineering, clinical, ops, and sales without a meeting, and hold the room when you do present, whether it's a design review, an exec update, or a customer pitch.

  • Curiosity and drive. You are the kind of person who studies the domain, not just the product.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and excitement about shaping what your role becomes.

  • Consumer product instincts. A sense for building things end users actually love, not just products that clear procurement.

  • Genuine passion for healthcare. Clinical experience, time at a healthtech company, or meaningful work alongside providers is a plus, but what matters most is that you care deeply about the space and want to spend your time changing how care gets delivered.

The team

We are a large and fast-growing team. High trust, low ego, and a strong bias toward jumping in to help. Product, engineering, design, clinical, and ops sit close and move as one team.

Why this matters

Every product decision you make either gives a provider back time with a patient or takes it away. Not many jobs let you feel that on a weekly basis. This one does. You are raising the quality of healthcare in the US, one shipped decision at a time.

What you can expect

  • Location: 3+ days in Mountain View

  • Travel: Light, mostly for onsite hospital and provider shadowing

  • Ownership: A real product surface end to end from day one

  • Growth: Clear path toward PM leadership as the team scales

  • Impact: Your work reaches tens of thousands of clinicians and the patients they serve every day

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description_html:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.

Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”

Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.

The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to own design direction for a healthcare domain spanning multiple interacting workflows and product surfaces. You’ll turn ambiguous clinical and operational problems into a clear design agenda, shape product direction with business partners, and lead design from discovery through launch. Your work will connect individual features into holistic, coherent experiences for the people who deliver care and run medical practices.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role. You’ll set a clear creative direction for your domain, turning user insights and product strategy into compelling concepts, coherent interaction models, and a vision that helps teams see what’s possible. Through clear communication and mentorship, you’ll help experienced designers and cross-functional partners strengthen their design judgment.

Our design team operates like a studio: we critique work, share approaches, and develop our craft together. We use realistic prototypes and AI-assisted workflows to explore ideas and test assumptions, and clear writing to sharpen our thinking, explain design decisions, and articulate their value to users and the business. We partner closely with product, engineering, and operations to turn that understanding into better healthcare workflows.

Location and travel: This is a full-time role based at our headquarters in Mountain View, CA, with a minimum of 3 days per week in the office and occasional travel to client sites for field research and direct user engagement.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the design agenda for a domain. Bring structure to ambiguous problems, connect workflows across product surfaces, and identify the most important opportunities to improve user and business outcomes. Define success with your cross-functional partners and use evidence to assess progress.

  • Shape product direction and roadmaps. Synthesize user research, customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints into a clear point of view. Partner with Product and Engineering to connect a longer-term experience vision to practical, sequenced investments.

  • Set and carry creative direction. Develop a strong point of view on how the product should work, look, and feel. Bring that direction to life through concepts, prototypes, and narratives, then guide the work through critique and implementation, raising the quality bar across teams while giving collaborators room to contribute.

  • Build deep understanding of users and their work. Lead research, including on-site observation and workflow testing, to understand clinical and practice operations. Map interactions across people, processes, and systems; uncover unmet needs and the root causes behind fragmented experiences.

  • Stay hands-on from concept through launch. Create clear interaction models, refined interfaces, and realistic prototypes. Validate ideas with users, address accessibility and edge cases, and work closely with engineers through implementation. Use feedback after launch to improve the experience.

  • Create durable patterns and shared approaches. Identify recurring problems across workflows and contribute reusable patterns, components, and abstractions to the design system. Help teams adopt approaches that improve coherence without ignoring meaningful differences in user needs.

  • Align people around clear decisions. Use design briefs, workflow maps, prototypes, and compelling narratives to explain opportunities and tradeoffs. Resolve competing priorities, coordinate dependencies across teams, and keep partners aligned through execution.

What You Have

  • A track record of domain-level ownership. You’ve led complex, end-to-end product design with impact across multiple workflows and teams. You can show how you helped define the problem, shaped direction, and stayed accountable through delivery and iteration.

  • Creative vision grounded in product judgment. You can move beyond incremental improvements to imagine better ways of working. Your portfolio shows how you established a direction, inspired others to build on it, and carried the strongest ideas into a shipped experience, including the tradeoffs you made and the outcomes of your work.

  • Exceptional interaction and visual craft. You simplify complex workflows without losing essential detail. Your work demonstrates strong information architecture, clear interaction models, thoughtful visual hierarchy, and attention to accessibility, edge cases, and error prevention.

  • Strong research, framing, and systems thinking. You turn incomplete information and conflicting requests into actionable insights and design opportunities. You build deep domain expertise and reason about how users, business operations, and technical systems interact.

  • Influence beyond your own execution. You’ve aligned cross-functional partners, mentored experienced designers, and improved the quality or effectiveness of work across teams. You can build trust, challenge assumptions constructively, and help others make sound decisions.

  • Clear writing and compelling storytelling. You can frame a problem in a design brief, articulate a domain-level vision, and explain decisions to design, technical, business, and customer audiences.

  • Applied experience with AI-assisted design and prototyping. You use tools such as Figma and AI-assisted development environments to explore concepts and build realistic prototypes, including code-based prototypes when appropriate. You can show how these workflows improved learning, quality, or speed, while protecting sensitive information and critically reviewing outputs. This expectation is about making ideas testable, not owning production engineering.

  • Ownership and sound judgment under ambiguity. You proactively identify work that matters, prioritize competing workstreams, communicate commitments, and balance speed with quality. You bring genuine curiosity about healthcare and the judgment to work in a high-trust environment.

What we offer

  • Meaningful ownership of complex healthcare problems, with influence over product direction and the opportunity to see your work through to real-world use.

  • A collaborative, studio-like design team that values critique, shared learning, and strong craft.

  • Opportunities to expand your impact through hands-on design, mentorship, and improvements that help multiple teams succeed.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, with support for professional development and learning.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

jobs.description_html:

As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.

This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.
  • Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment.
  • Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk.
  • Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear.
  • Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value.
  • Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens.
  • Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges.
  • Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.
  • Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.
  • Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Required:
    • 5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users.
    • A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline.
    • Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions.
    • Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them.
    • Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.
    • Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.
    • Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.
    • Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.
    • Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.
    • Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.
    • A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.
  • Highly desired:
    • Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.
    • Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.
    • Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise.
  • A plus
    • Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices.
    • Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns.
    • Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts.

You will work with a small, high-impact team alongside tech leads, principals, and partner engineering groups. You will ship systems that plan, implement, review, test, and operate work with strong guardrails, then drive adoption until those tools become part of how Cribl builds software. You will also bring a builder mentality: use the product yourself to solve real team and Engineering problems, then turn that lived experience into better systems. Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone.

  • Bring a builder mentality: dogfood what we ship. Use the platform to unblock yourself and the team, surface sharp edges, and turn real usage into product and platform improvements

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY / Philadelphia, PA / Boston, MA
jobs.description_html:
Daymark Health is a value-based oncology company redefining the cancer care experience for patients, providers, and health plans. Daymark’s comprehensive, personalized cancer care platform empowers patients with dedicated care navigation, symptom-focused support, behavioral health care, and social resources. Combined with evidence-based health interventions and a hybrid in-person + virtual care model, Daymark is improving the overall cancer experience for patients, providers, and health plans – and setting a new standard in cancer care. 

Daymark’s groundbreaking approach is led by CEO Dr. Justin Bekelman, a pioneer in transforming cancer care, alongside some of the nation’s foremost leaders in oncology and value-based care. Daymark Health is backed by Maverick Ventures, Yosemite, Oncology Ventures, Healthier Capital, Blue Venture Fund, and Healthcare Foundry.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Daymark Health email.

 

THE ROLE

Daymark Health is looking for an Associate Product Manager to serve as an operational center point for our product and engineering team. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product experience who is ready to take on real ownership. You’ll keep our proprietary Care Management platform moving forward day to day — writing and refining tickets, keeping the backlog organized, coordinating QA, triaging bugs and feature requests, and serving as a first point of contact for clinical and operational teams’ tech support questions. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Operations, and Clinical teams, building the operational rigor that lets our small product team move quickly and reliably while directly supporting the people who deliver care to our patients every day.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the backlog: Keep the product backlog organized — refining tickets, tagging and prioritizing work, and making sure items are clear and ready for engineering pickup.
  • Write requirements: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design leads to translate needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and lightweight specs.
  • Run product operations: Help plan and run day-to-day product rituals — sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retros — and keep cross-functional partners informed on status, risks, and blockers.
  • Triage bugs and feature requests: Serve as the first stop for incoming bug reports and feature requests. Investigate issues to understand root cause and impact, and work with Engineering to prioritize and track fixes to resolution.
  • Support our clinical and care teams: Be a first point of contact for clinical and operational teams’ tech support questions, troubleshooting issues directly and routing more complex escalations to Engineering.
  • Coordinate QA and releases: Help plan and run QA/UAT for new features, testing functionality, verifying fixes, and confirming releases are ready to ship. Communicate what’s changing to the teams it affects.
  • Maintain documentation: Keep product specs, workflows, known issues, and release notes clear and up to date so teams across Daymark always know what’s shipped and what’s in flight.
  • Support discovery and research: Gather feedback from clinical and care teams through shadowing, interviews, and data, and help translate what you learn into clear problem statements and opportunities.
  • Operate with a bias to action: Jump in on urgent operational needs and help solve problems even when they fall outside your core scope.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience: You bring 2+ years of professional experience in product management, product operations, project management, QA, or a comparable operational role. Experience in healthcare is required, preferably in a care delivery or clinical software context.
  • Stakeholder Management: You have strong organizational and project management skills and know how to bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations. You can manage a busy backlog, a stream of bug reports, and multiple stakeholders at once without dropping details.
  • Strong communicator: You communicate clearly and confidently with a range of audiences, including clinical staff, and can translate between technical and non-technical language and between clinical workflows and product requirements.
  • Ownership mindset: You take initiative and are comfortable operating with autonomy. You don’t need a senior level of expertise to get things done well — you figure out what’s needed and make it happen, and you know when to loop in others.
  • Healthcare fluency: You have direct experience in the healthcare space and are motivated to deeply understand clinician, care team, and patient workflows. Experience with EHR systems or care management/coordination platforms is a plus.
  • Tech-savvy: You’re comfortable with product and project management tools such as Jira, Linear, Asana, Notion, Claude or Figma, and you pick up new systems quickly.
  • Detail-oriented: You sweat the details on documentation, QA, and requirements — in healthcare, small gaps in a spec or a missed edge case can affect real patient care.
  • Collaborative: You work well across teams and enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, clinicians, and operators alike.
  • Mission-first: You are motivated by the opportunity to improve the healthcare system and aligned with Daymark’s mission to transform cancer care for patients, families, and providers.

This role is fully remote but we are ideally looking for someone based in New York, Philadelphia, or Boston to align with our team's current geographic distribution. 

Compensation: $100,000 - $115,000 annually, depending on location & experience.

Daymark Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

All Daymark Health patient-facing roles require Basic Life Support (BLS) certification and compliance with Daymark's Employee Vaccination and Testing policy. Candidates without these at the time of hire should coordinate with their recruiter and hiring manager to ensure they meet the requirements by their start date.

All roles that require in-home visits to patients must provide proof of a valid driver's license.

jobs.description_html:
Why Join Doppel

Doppel is built to outsmart one of the great threats AI presents: mass-manufactured social engineering. Countless scams, deepfakes, and other social engineering attacks are surging across every digital channel: websites, social media, ads, encrypted messaging apps, mobile, and more. Our mission is simple but bold: make the internet a safer place by outsmarting the world’s fastest-evolving digital threats.

Backed by a16z and Bessemer and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands (OpenAI, United Airlines, Coinbase, etc.), Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to elevate every aspect of UI/UX across our core product platform. You’ll work closely with our lead designer to create a cohesive, performant, and modern user experience that instills confidence and trust in enterprise customers. Your work will directly influence seven-figure deals and how customers and internal teams interact with our product.

What You'll be Doing

Doppel's Frontend Platform team is building toward something that hasn't really been done: a frontend platform so complete that product teams no longer need to do frontend development. Designers and product engineers describe what they want; the platform — a rigorously constrained design system, agent-driven code generation, and paved-road infrastructure with permissions, telemetry, turns it into production code. We've already proven the foundation works: our modern stack (React 19, Relay, a custom UI kit with agent-enforced golden paths) is explicitly designed so AI agents generate reviewable, production-safe frontend code. Your job is to close the remaining gap between design and production. This is a small team with an ambitious, still-forming charter at a company rapidly expanding its product portfolio — you'll shape what it becomes, and every product Doppel ships will run on what you build.

  • Build and maintain the frontend infrastructure every product runs on: the application shell, data layer, routing, auth, and build/deploy pipeline — so product teams ship features, not frontend plumbing.

  • Evolve the design system from a component library into a contract: constrained, composable primitives with tokens, docs, and guardrails tight enough that generated code is correct by construction.

  • Build the design-to-production pipeline: the tooling, agent workflows, and review guardrails that let designers and product teams go from a design to a shipped, production-quality surface without hand-writing frontend code.

  • Make the platform safe by default: permissioning and packaging gates, observability, accessibility, and internationalization baked into the primitives rather than re-implemented per feature.

  • Own production health of the shared client: monitors, SLOs, and ownership routing so failures page the right team automatically and the platform stays trustworthy enough to build on blindly.

  • Package the platform for scale: a versioned component library and scaffolding that lets new apps and product surfaces spin up on the paved road from day one.

  • Partner closely with design and product teams as your customers — their velocity is your success metric.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in React and TypeScript, building and operating production web applications.

  • Experience owning platform-level frontend work: design systems, component libraries, build tooling, data-layer patterns (Relay or similar GraphQL clients), or frontend infrastructure other engineers build on.

  • Genuine excitement about AI-assisted development — you see agents as a way to raise the abstraction level of frontend work, and you want to build the rails that make that safe.

  • A platform mindset: you measure success by what other teams (and designers) can ship without you, not by features you shipped yourself.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity — the team's charter is being defined in real time as the company grows, and you'll shape it rather than inherit it.

  • Familiarity with production monitoring and performance work (RUM, SLOs, error budgets) is a strong plus.

  • Experience collaborating deeply with designers — design tokens, Figma workflows, Storybook-driven development — is a strong plus.

  • Strong communication skills: your customers are product teams, designers, and backend platform engineers.

  • Product-minded, highly autonomous, and comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll define how our users, customers and internal teams, experience Doppel’s core platform. Your work will directly shape the look, feel, and velocity of the company’s most visible product surface.

What We Offer

🚀 A mission-driven culture with low ego, high ownership, deep customer obsession, and exceptional talent density

🍽️ Free lunch and dinner in the office

🌴 Flexible PTO

✈️ Quarterly team offsites

Join Doppel

Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective.

We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description_html:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

We are seeking a highly motivated and versatile Director of Product Design to join our startup, building products at the intersection of cyber-security and software development to disrupt the large Application Security market. The ideal candidate will have full-stack experience spanning user research, interaction design, and visual design. They will have demonstrable results delivering delightful security and developer experiences via a SaaS service.
