jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

Senior Product Manager, Identity Products

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to build and take to market a new category of products at Socure: proactive identity notifications. These are subscription products that continuously monitor identities on our customers' behalf and push an alert when something material about that identity changes.

This is a zero-to-one role with a near-term launch. You will own the first product in this line end to end: defining what good looks like, closing any performance gaps that stand between us and a product customers will pay for, shaping the event contract and subscription model, and running it from beta through GA. More event types will follow close behind, and the scope will continue to expand as the portfolio grows.

Data is the heart of this role. The quality of a proactive notification product is the quality of the data underneath it: how much of the real world it sees, how accurate it is, and how quickly it knows. You will own that. You will establish the performance metrics that define success, decide what we need to source and what a candidate source has to prove, and make the call on which sources have earned their place and which have not. A dedicated Data Partnerships team runs discovery, negotiation, licensing, and vendor management against the brief you set, alongside data science and engineering.

You will also own commercialization. Pricing and packaging, commercial terms, early-adopter recruitment, beta and GA phasing, enablement, and coordinating every function to a launch date all sit with you.

This is a highly technical and highly commercial role. It suits a PM who is equally comfortable arguing about precision and recall methodology with a data scientist in the morning and defending a pricing model to the executive team in the afternoon.

What you'll do

Product definition and launch

  • Own the roadmap, definition, and launch of proactive identity notification products, from first beta customer through general availability.

  • Define the customer-facing event contract: what the notification contains, its lifecycle semantics, and how customers consume and act on it.

  • Design a systematic customer feedback loop so every notification we send makes the next one better.

  • Begin the product definition for the next event types on the roadmap, where the customer problem is more open-ended and the framing work is still to be done.

Data source strategy

  • Own what we source and why: define the gaps in our coverage, specify what a candidate source must prove, and set the bar it has to clear. Data Partnerships runs discovery and commercial negotiation against that brief.

  • Run rigorous, hypothesis-driven evaluations that measure incremental lift rather than headline coverage claims, and make the buy, build, or walk-away call.

  • Specify the licensing, retention, and derivative-use terms the product needs, and treat them as first-class inputs to every sourcing decision rather than an afterthought. Legal, Data Protection, and Data Partnerships paper the deal.

  • Hold the portfolio to its KPIs: decide which sources have earned their cost, which need renegotiating, and which to retire.

Performance measurement and KPIs

  • Define and instrument the KPIs for this product line, including coverage, precision, and recency, and build the internal benchmarking capability to measure them independent of customer-reported feedback.

  • Go a step further than measurement: define the target for each KPI that constitutes winning in the market. This requires competitive benchmarking and direct customer research, and it is the most important judgment call in the role.

  • Quantify the incremental value a subscriber receives per period, and use it to inform pricing and positioning.

  • Use SQL and analytics tooling to interrogate the data yourself rather than waiting on someone else's analysis.

Architecture and platform partnership

  • Partner with platform engineering teams to define how identity signals are resolved, merged across sources, and published, and make the architectural tradeoff calls on where that processing belongs.

  • Shape a generalized, reusable notification mechanism so each new event type is faster to ship than the last.

  • Balance latency, cost, and refresh cadence against the customer value each incremental improvement buys.

Commercialization and go-to-market

  • Define pricing, packaging, and commercial terms for a subscription product, in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Revenue.

  • Identify, recruit, and work hand-in-hand with early-adopter and design-partner customers.

  • Establish and track beta and GA phases, and coordinate cross-functional readiness, including end-to-end testing, to a committed date.

  • Build the positioning, marketing plan, and sales enablement materials with Product Marketing, and be the internal subject matter expert the field relies on.

Customer and competitive research

  • Build a firm, evidence-based read on how we perform against market leaders and where our real differentiation lies.

  • Understand the bar customers will actually accept, and be willing to say which customers and use cases we should not sell to yet.

  • Assess and design around the business risk of getting a high-stakes identity signal wrong.

What you bring

  • Experience: 5+ years in product management, preferably in identity verification, fraud prevention, data products, or other data- and ML-driven products.

  • Data product instinct: Demonstrated experience evaluating, acquiring, and operationalizing acquired data, including designing tests that isolate incremental lift and making the call to walk away when a source doesn't deliver.

  • Technical expertise: Strong understanding of APIs, SQL, databases, event-driven architectures, and product architecture generally.

  • Analytical skills: Comfortable working with data directly, writing queries, and defining measurement methodology, including precision, recall, and coverage benchmarking, to inform product decisions.

  • Commercial judgment on data deals: Has been the product voice in data or technology vendor negotiations; knows what to ask a provider to prove, how licensing, retention, and derivative-use terms constrain what you can build, and when a deal is not worth doing.

  • Commercial ownership: Experience taking a product to market, covering pricing, packaging, beta programs, and launch, not just shipping features.

  • Product judgment: Ability to balance technical complexity, customer needs, regulatory constraints, and business impact, and to set a defensible bar for "good enough to launch" when no precedent exists.

  • Customer focus: Experience working directly with customers, especially in complex or high-stakes environments.

  • Communication: Strong ability to explain complex technical and data concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, up to and including the executive team.

  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Legal, and go-to-market teams.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with consumer data regulatory frameworks such as GLBA and FCRA, and how they shape product and commercial design.

  • Experience with entity resolution, identity graphs, or record-linkage systems.

  • Experience building a subscription or usage-based data product from zero to first revenue.

jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

Role overview

Socure is redefining digital identity. Our products help organizations establish trust, prevent fraud, manage risk, and make better decisions across digital journeys.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help make Socure’s products clear, trustworthy, and fast. Depending on business priorities, you may work on RiskOS workflows, agentic experiences, self-serve onboarding, Document Verification, customer and developer experiences, or new product opportunities. You will work on problems that span complex enterprise workflows, AI-assisted decisioning, customer onboarding, and the systems that help customers move from evaluation to successful operation.

This is a hands-on product design role for someone who can move confidently from research and problem framing through exploration, prototyping, testing, detailed execution, and launch. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, solution consultants, customer-facing teams, and design leadership to reduce the time and effort required to understand, adopt, integrate, and operate Socure products.

The right candidate does not need to be an expert in identity or fraud on day one. They need strong product judgment, systems thinking, curiosity about technical systems, and the ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into simple, clear solutions without oversimplifying the decisions that matter.

Role details

  • Team: Design

  • Title: Senior Product Designer

  • Location: San Francisco, CA · Hybrid

  • Level: Senior · IC

  • Type: Full-time

  • Start: Immediate

What you’ll do

Understand the problem

  • Work with researchers, product managers, engineers, solution consultants, and customers to understand builder goals, technical constraints, operational needs, and barriers to adoption.

  • Partner with the researcher to conduct customer interviews, usability studies, workflow reviews, competitive research, and product-data analysis.

  • Synthesize research and product signals into clear themes, opportunity areas, user needs, and design implications.

  • Build enough domain fluency in identity verification, fraud prevention, KYC, watchlist screening, compliance, and risk decisioning to make responsible design decisions.

Frame the right problem

  • Turn ambiguous business and customer needs into clearly framed problems, measurable outcomes, and practical design hypotheses.

  • Map end-to-end customer and user journeys across product discovery, onboarding, configuration, integration, decisioning, case management, operations, and ongoing use.

  • Identify where customers lose time, confidence, or momentum—and help the team prioritize the problems with the greatest effect on activation, time-to-value, implementation effort, and trust.

  • Partner with product and engineering early enough to shape the problem and solution, not just polish a predetermined feature.

Explore and validate solutions

  • Generate and compare multiple approaches before converging on a direction.

  • Design flows for use-case discovery, account setup, workflow configuration, agent interaction, API keys, test identities, sandbox testing, usage visibility, case management, production readiness, and ongoing operations.

  • Prototype at the right fidelity—from quick flows and low-fidelity concepts to realistic Figma, coded, or AI-assisted prototypes connected to representative states and data.

  • Test concepts with customers and internal users, document what was learned, and iterate quickly based on evidence.

  • Design for the full range of states that make technical products usable: loading, empty, success, partial completion, validation, permissions, errors, unavailable services, uncertain results, and recovery.

Deliver high-quality product design

  • Produce clear, detailed designs and specifications that engineers can build accurately and efficiently.

  • Connect product interfaces, APIs, documentation, dashboards, hosted UI, agentic interactions, developer tools, and operational workflows into coherent experiences.

  • Make complex RiskOS capabilities—identity graph, Sigma fraud models, Predictive DocV, watchlist screening, KYC, fraud, and compliance workflows—understandable to builders without hiding meaningful tradeoffs.

  • Design experiences that help customers move from understanding a problem to evaluating, configuring, integrating, and successfully operating a Socure solution.

  • Partner through implementation, review working software, perform design QA, and refine the experience based on real behavior and feedback.

  • Present work clearly, explain tradeoffs, respond constructively to critique, and make decisions visible to cross-functional partners.

Use AI to increase speed and quality

  • Use tools such as Figma AI, Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor to accelerate research synthesis, content exploration, flow generation, prototyping, design critique, documentation, and design QA.

  • Use AI as a collaborator for breadth and speed while applying independent judgment to evaluate outputs, protect user trust, and make the final design decisions.

  • Create realistic prototypes and testable product concepts with AI-assisted or coded workflows when static screens cannot answer the product question.

  • Document important context, design rationale, behavioral rules, and edge cases so that both people and AI-assisted development tools can use the work accurately.

  • Help the team develop responsible patterns for AI-assisted design, including privacy, security, transparency, human oversight, and safe handling of customer information.

Strengthen the system around the work

  • Contribute reusable patterns to the Socure design system across navigation, forms, workflow configuration, status, permissions, API keys, environments, testing, billing, and usage.

  • Identify when a new component, pattern, or content convention should become part of the shared system rather than a one-off solution.

  • Work with designers and engineers to improve consistency between Figma, coded components, documentation, and shipped product behavior.

  • Share methods, findings, and practical feedback through design critiques, working sessions, and cross-functional reviews.

What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of product design experience designing and shipping digital products, with ownership of meaningful product areas from discovery through delivery.

  • A portfolio showing strong end-to-end product thinking: the problem, the evidence, the options considered, the final experience, the implementation, and the outcome.

  • Experience designing self-serve, product-led, developer-facing, SaaS, fintech, workflow, platform, or other technically complex products.

  • Strong research and synthesis skills. You can choose an appropriate method, ask useful questions, distinguish evidence from assumptions, and turn findings into decisions.

  • Strong problem-framing skills. You can define the user, context, unmet need, business objective, constraints, and success measures before jumping into screens.

  • Strong interaction and visual design craft, including information architecture, workflows, forms, states, content hierarchy, accessibility, and responsive behavior.

  • Experience exploring multiple directions and validating concepts through prototypes, usability testing, customer feedback, or product data.

  • Ability to design for complex systems and non-happy paths, including permissions, configuration, dependencies, errors, asynchronous work, and transitions between environments.

  • Product judgment: you understand how design can improve activation, conversion, time-to-value, implementation effort, retention, operational efficiency, and customer trust.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to collaborate with engineers on APIs, data, system behavior, integrations, front-end constraints, and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable learning how the product works.

  • Experience working with a design system and contributing patterns that are reusable, accessible, documented, and feasible to implement.

  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Figma AI, Cursor, or comparable tools to improve speed, exploration, research, prototyping, or documentation.

  • The judgment to know when AI output is useful, when it is misleading, and what still requires human research, reasoning, taste, and accountability.

  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain complex ideas to executives, product managers, engineers, researchers, and customers.

  • Comfort working in an environment where priorities evolve, information is incomplete, and progress depends on proactive collaboration.

What success looks like

In this role, you will help Socure:

  • Reduce the time it takes for a new customer to understand the right solution and reach a meaningful first test.

  • Make Socure products easier to understand, evaluate, configure, integrate, and operate across enterprise, self-serve, and agentic experiences.

  • Increase confidence in Socure’s risk decisions by making system behavior, status, requirements, and next steps clear.

  • Reduce avoidable implementation and support effort through better flows, reusable patterns, and clearer documentation.

  • Help product and engineering teams make better decisions earlier through research, prototypes, and explicit design rationale.

  • Increase design throughput without lowering the quality, accessibility, consistency, or trustworthiness of the experience.

Tools and environment

  • Figma and Figma AI

  • Claude and ChatGPT

  • Cursor and AI-assisted coding or prototyping tools

  • Design systems and component libraries

  • Prototyping and usability-testing tools

  • APIs, documentation, dashboards, hosted components, agentic workflows, and enterprise product experiences

  • Analytics, customer feedback, research repositories, and product-data tools

We use Figma as our primary design tool and actively incorporate AI-assisted workflows into how we research, explore, prototype, document, and review product experiences. We are interested in candidates who are curious and practical about these tools—not candidates who use AI as a substitute for design thinking.

Nice to have

  • Experience with developer tools, APIs, SDKs, webhooks, hosted UI components, or technical documentation.

  • Experience designing sandbox, test-mode, simulation, staging, environment-management, or operational workflows.

  • Experience with pricing, billing, usage metering, credits, entitlements, or plan comparisons.

  • Experience in fintech, identity, fraud, compliance, crypto, marketplaces, infrastructure, or other trust-sensitive domains.

  • Basic familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or front-end implementation.

  • Experience designing AI-assisted workflows, agentic products, conversational interfaces, or systems with probabilistic outputs.

  • Experience working with accessibility standards, content design, or responsible AI and trust patterns.

About the team

You’ll join a collaborative product design team working closely with product, engineering, research, growth, solution consulting, customer success, and other customer-facing teams. The team values strong craft, direct communication, thoughtful research, rapid learning, and close partnership through implementation.

This role has meaningful ownership from day one. You will be expected to lead the design work for defined product areas, influence decisions through evidence and clear reasoning, and raise the quality of the work around you through collaboration and critique. You will have support from design leadership and senior partners while remaining accountable for moving your work forward.

Portfolio requirement

A portfolio is required. Please show one or two substantial product-design projects that demonstrate how you:

  • Understood the users and business context.

  • Framed the problem and defined success.

  • Used research, data, or testing to guide decisions.

  • Explored alternatives and made tradeoffs.

  • Designed the complete experience, including important states and edge cases.

  • Worked with engineering through implementation.

  • Measured or assessed the outcome and learned from it.

We care about the quality of the thinking and the shipped result—not only polished screens.

About Socure

Socure is the leading AI identity verification and fraud prevention platform, trusted by over 3,000 customers including top financial institutions, fintechs, and government agencies.

Socure’s products bring together identity intelligence, fraud prevention, document verification, compliance checks, and AI-native decisioning to help organizations establish trust and manage risk. Our teams are building the next generation of experiences across RiskOS, self-serve products, agentic workflows, Document Verification, and other products that make trusted digital interactions possible.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Performance Management
jobs.description_html:
Why Socure?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.

About Socure

Socure is the leading provider of digital identity verification and fraud solutions, powering the world’s largest financial institutions, fintechs, and digital brands. Our mission is to verify 100% of good identities in real time while eliminating identity fraud for every application on the internet. The People Team at Socure is building a high-performance, AI-enabled, and human-centered workplace, and this role plays a critical part in how we set, support, and sustain that performance and organizational health through scalable programs and data-informed insight.

Job Summary

The Sr. Program Manager, Performance is a strategic, hands-on program owner responsible for designing, running, and continuously improving Socure’s performance operating system.

Reporting to the Head of Talent Development & OE, this role owns end-to-end delivery of goal-setting, check-ins, continuous feedback, recognition, and performance reviews, and partners closely on the talent planning work that draws on that data — calibration, talent mapping, and action planning. The ideal candidate pairs strong program management with people analytics fluency and knows how to use AI-enabled tools and systems to scale a high-adoption, high-trust performance culture.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end execution of the performance operating system — goal-setting, progress check-ins, continuous feedback, recognition, and performance reviews/assessments — from cycle design and calendar through configuration, communications, training, and post-cycle retrospective.

  • Administer and optimize Socure’s performance platform(s) (e.g., 15Five, Workday), including configuration, adoption tracking, manager and employee enablement, and ongoing evaluation of whether tools continue to meet the business’s needs as Socure scales.

  • Design and run recognition programs (e.g., peer recognition, performance-based awards), exploring recognition levers beyond compensation and measuring their impact on engagement and retention.

  • Build and facilitate the calibration process for performance ratings, ensuring consistent standards across managers & functions, and partnering with People Partners on manager enablement and bias mitigation.

  • Partner with Total Rewards to ensure a cohesive talent cycle across performance and compensation, and that performance outcomes connect cleanly to pay-for-performance decisions.

  • Leverage People Analytics and AI‑enabled tools (e.g., dashboards, 15Five/Kona insights, generative AI) to synthesize data, generate reports, and surface trends that inform decisions. Use data and manager/employee feedback to continuously refine the operating system.

  • Build and maintain the playbooks, templates, manager guides, and communications that support each part of the performance cycle, and identify opportunities to automate recurring workflows (reminders, nominations, reporting) using AI-enabled tools.

  • Partner closely with HRBPs, HR Tech, Total Rewards, and business leaders to ensure programs are well understood, consistently adopted, and localized where needed; serve as the day-to-day point of contact for performance program questions and escalations.

  • Stay current on market practice in performance management and talent planning, bringing external benchmarks and emerging approaches (e.g., continuous performance management, AI-enabled coaching) into program design.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree.

  • 6–8+ years of relevant experience in program management, performance management, HR/People programs, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-paced or tech environment.

  • Proven experience owning an end-to-end performance or talent program (design, plan, launch, execution, iteration).

  • Working knowledge of talent planning concepts (9-box/talent mapping, calibration, succession, capability/skills-gap assessment) and how they connect to performance data.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in people analytics and data storytelling — comfortable working with data and building dashboards or reporting views for leaders.

  • Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, build clear plans, manage dependencies, and deliver on time.

  • Experience configuring or optimizing performance/feedback platforms (e.g., 15Five, Lattice, Workday) is a plus.

  • Experience using AI or automation tools to streamline workflows (drafting communications, summarizing feedback, generating reports) or strong aptitude to learn.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate performance data and program mechanics into clear guidance for executives, managers, and individual contributors.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without authority across People sub-teams and business partners.

  • High attention to detail and ownership, and comfort operating with a mix of structure and ambiguity as programs evolve.

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
As a Senior Data Product Manager at Talkiatry, you will own the evolution of our data stack, end user data enablement strategy and our third party integrations (including referrals, billing and more). This role reaches into nearly every part of Talkiatry's practice, and asks you to balance day-to-day execution against a strategic view of how our data capabilities should evolve. You will partner closely with Referrals, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, and other Product teams to identify high-impact opportunities, define long-term direction, and deliver scalable solutions across Talkiatry's data ecosystem. This includes putting more capability directly in the hands of the people who need it: AI functionality, self-serve analytics, configurable attribution, and marketer-controlled segmentation that don't require an engineering ticket. You will expand our metrics and proprietary data layers so that the definitions the business runs on are trustworthy and owned. And you will grow the data foundation underneath our Referrals business and the features we offer partner organizations. This is a role for someone comfortable at two altitudes: system design, data flows, definitions, and integration debugging on one hand; roadmap, tradeoffs, and executive alignment on the other.

 

About Talkiatry:

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

 

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

 

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

 

You will:

  • Lead product strategy and execution for our data platform, third party integrations, and end user data enablement

  • Develop and maintain a long-term roadmap for the data stack, our metrics layers, proprietary data models and data user AI capabilities

  • Own third party integrations across referrals, billing, marketing, and clinical systems

  • Own data quality and reliability as product requirements, with validation, monitoring, and alerting that catch problems early

  • Identify where AI and automation add real value to end data users

  • Put analytics, attribution, and segmentation directly in the hands of Marketing, Operations, and Finance without engineering dependencies

  • Balance short-term operational priorities with long-term platform investments and scalability goals

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data, Clinical, and Operations partners to deliver complex initiatives successfully

  • Anticipate dependencies across interconnected systems, drive alignment, and break ambiguous problems into prioritized opportunities

  • Define success metrics, establish measurable goals, and use data to evaluate product impact and inform strategic decisions

  • Navigate ambiguity by breaking down complex operational and systems challenges into actionable product opportunities

You have:

  • 4+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years on data platform, data products, or data infrastructure

  • Working fluency with the modern data stack: ELT, cloud warehousing, transformation, orchestration, BI and semantic layers, and reverse ETL

  • Comfort reading and writing SQL, and the ability to reason independently about grain, joins, duplication, and completeness

  • Experience leading complex product initiatives across multiple teams and systems

  • Experience owning metric definitions and governance, including resolving competing definitions across teams

  • Track record of building self-serve data capability for non-technical teams and measurably reducing ad hoc request volume

  • Experience writing accurate, concise and up to date product documentation for Engineering and Design handoffs as well as stakeholder reviews

  • Demonstrated ability to develop product strategy, prioritize effectively, and execute against long-term roadmaps

  • Strong interest in AI-driven products, with the ability to identify practical applications of AI

  • Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including automation, large language models (LLMs), and decision-support systems

  • Experience working across interconnected systems and understanding technical dependencies, integrations, and operational trade-offs

  • Strong product judgment and ability to navigate ambiguity in complex problem spaces

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to clearly articulate priorities, trade-offs, and strategic rationale

Why Talkiatry:

  • Top-notch team: we're a diverse, experienced group motivated to make a difference in mental health care

  • Collaborative environment: be part of building something from the ground up at a fast-paced startup

  • Excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, effective day 1 of employment, 401K with match, generous PTO plus paid holidays, paid parental leave, and more!

  • Grow your career with us: hone your skills and build new ones with our Learning team as Talkiatry expands

  • It all comes back to care: we’re a mental health company, and we put our team’s well-being first

Talkiatry participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. only after a job offer is accepted and Form I-9 is completed. For more information on E-Verify, please visit the following: EVerify Participation & IER Right to Work.

We are looking for this individual to bring analytical thought leadership as we continue to rapidly grow and iterate on our product offerings across Talkiatry.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description_html:
Talkiatry is looking for a Staff Product Designer to shape the future of mental health care experiences across multiple strategic product areas. You'll lead design work spanning our Clinical AI products, patient portal experiences, and design system evolution—helping define how patients interact with psychiatric care in both AI-assisted and human-centered contexts.

In this role, you'll divide your time across several high-impact areas: designing AI-powered experiences that support patients between sessions, improving core patient portal flows that help people access and manage their care, and serving as a craft leader who modernizes our design system and raises the visual quality bar across all Talkiatry products.

As a Staff designer, your impact will extend beyond any single product area. You'll work closely with product, engineering, clinical, and AI partners across multiple teams, bringing both deep craft and strategic thinking to ambiguous problems. You'll help establish interaction patterns for emerging technologies while also refining foundational experiences that serve patients every day.

We're looking for a designer who is energized by variety and ambiguity, capable of moving between AI-enabled experiences and core product flows, and equally passionate about interaction design, systems thinking, and exceptional visual craft.

About Talkiatry:

Talkiatry is transforming mental health care by making high-quality psychiatry more accessible, human, and sustainable for both patients and clinicians. Co-founded by a patient and a triple-board-certified psychiatrist, we were built to solve one of healthcare’s most urgent challenges: millions of people struggle to access mental health care, while clinicians face growing administrative burden and burnout. Through our technology-powered, in-network platform, we’re changing that, creating a better experience for patients and empowering clinicians to focus on delivering exceptional care.

 

Today, Talkiatry is the largest dedicated psychiatry practice in the U.S., with 750+ psychiatrists, 250+ therapists, and more than two million patient visits delivered nationwide. At our scale, every innovation has real impact. Every workflow we improve, every technology solution we build, and every patient experience we redesign helps thousands of clinicians provide better care to hundreds of thousands of patients. We’re not just growing quickly — we’re redefining how behavioral healthcare is delivered in America.

 

Joining Talkiatry means joining a mission-driven team that is solving complex problems at scale, driving meaningful change in healthcare, and building the future of mental health care with compassion, innovation, and purpose.

You will:

  • Lead product design across multiple strategic areas, including Clinical AI experiences, patient portal flows, and design system evolution.

  • Design AI-powered experiences that support patients between scheduled psychiatry sessions, from early concepts through launch and iteration.

  • Define how patients interact with conversational AI, helping establish patterns for experiences that may not yet have conventional design precedents.

  • Improve core patient portal experiences, including intake flows, appointment management, visit preparation, and other touchpoints that help patients access and navigate their care.

  • Translate complex AI capabilities and limitations into intuitive, transparent, and trustworthy product experiences.

  • Partner deeply with Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams across multiple product areas to shape product strategy and determine what we build.

  • Prototype and test interaction patterns—from conversational AI flows to traditional web and mobile experiences—to learn quickly and reduce uncertainty.

  • Advocate for patient needs while helping teams navigate safety, trust, accessibility, and usability considerations across both AI-powered and traditional product experiences.

  • Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Use research, product data, experimentation, and qualitative feedback to continuously improve experiences after launch.

  • Bring exceptional interaction and visual design craft to all your work, from early product thinking through highly polished final execution.

  • Serve as a senior individual-contributor design leader, influencing product and design decisions across your areas of ownership and beyond.

  • Lead the evolution of Talkiatry's design system, defining the next generation of our visual design language and establishing patterns that scale across web, mobile, and emerging interaction models.

  • Raise the craft bar across the Product Design team through thoughtful critique, mentorship, collaboration, and high-quality example-setting.

You have:

  • 7+ years of product design experience, including experience owning complex digital products from discovery through implementation and iteration.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking, interaction design, and exceptional visual/UI craft. A portfolio is required for consideration.

  • Strong experience designing rich web and native mobile products.

  • Experience operating with a high degree of autonomy and leading design within ambiguous or zero-to-one product spaces.

  • Experience designing products where trust and transparency are critical to the user experience.

  • Strong systems thinking and the ability to design individual experiences while considering the broader product ecosystem.

  • Deep understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual hierarchy, typography, layout, and responsive interface design.

  • Strong user research skills with the ability to independently plan and conduct user research, usability testing, and synthesize insights to inform design decisions.

  • Experience creating and evolving scalable design systems, or a strong point of view on how systems can improve both product quality and team velocity.

  • Strong prototyping skills and the ability to communicate complex interactions before they are fully built.

  • Experience collaborating closely with product managers and engineers and contributing meaningfully to product strategy, not just execution.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain design rationale, facilitate productive critique, and influence senior cross-functional partners.

  • Curiosity about emerging technologies and a willingness to learn through experimentation when established design patterns do not yet exist.

We'd be especially excited if you have:

  • Experience designing conversational interfaces, chat-based products, voice experiences, or AI assistants.

  • Experience designing products powered by AI, machine learning, or large language models.

  • Experience establishing interaction patterns for emerging technologies where best practices are still being defined.

  • Experience in healthcare or regulated industries.

  • Experience helping establish or significantly evolve the visual language of a product or design system.

  • Experience designing patient-facing or consumer health products.

This role includes work on emerging AI experiences, but we don't expect candidates to have spent years designing AI products. Genuine enthusiasm for the space, strong foundational product-design skills, and evidence that you can thoughtfully tackle unfamiliar interaction problems matter more than having a particular AI job title on your résumé.

Healthcare experience is not required, but is a plus.

Why Talkiatry's Product Team:

  • Make a meaningful impact: Help build products designed to expand access to high-quality mental health care and improve the patient experience.

  • Work across the product portfolio: Move between AI-powered experiences, core patient flows, and design system work, with variety and strategic influence across multiple product areas.

  • Shape an emerging product space: Work at the intersection of mental health, product design, and AI, where many of the interaction patterns have yet to be invented.

  • Join a talented, collaborative team: Work alongside experienced people across design, product, engineering, clinical care, and operations who are motivated by a shared mission.

  • Lead design system evolution: Play a central role in modernizing our design system, raising craft standards, and shaping how Product Design grows at Talkiatry.

  • Work remotely: This role is remote within the United States.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Talkiatry offers medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company match, generous paid time off and company holidays, paid parental leave, and additional employee benefits.

  • Keep growing: Develop new skills and expand your impact as Talkiatry and the Product Design organization continue to grow.

  • It all comes back to care: We're a mental health company, and the well-being of our patients, providers, and team informs how we work.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description_html:
Company Description

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist, your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often providers are overwhelmed with the painstakingly tedious work required to get paid by insurance companies. Powered by proprietary models, Tennr handles the complex paperwork that gets patients through the door and providers paid, helping operators get patients the right care, at the right time, in the right setting.

Role Description

As we scale our product surface area, we’re looking for Product Managers who are excited to own a variety of high-impact products, and drive outsized outcomes in hard-to-solve and ambiguous problem spaces. This is a role designed for builders who thrive in ambiguity, love solving complex user and workflow problems, and take full ownership of outcomes - from defining the problem space to shipping, scaling, and driving real customer and business impact.

As a Product Manager, you will be accountable for setting the vision, strategy, and end-to-end execution of one or more core product areas. This is not a “manage the roadmap” role—it’s a “make it successful” role. You’ll develop a deep understanding of users, their day-to-day workflows, and the broader ecosystem they operate in. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems to solve and turn messy, real-world complexity into simple, scalable experiences. You will hold the standard on quality, and not rest until your product is creating the level of impact in the field that you expect.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, customer-facing teams, and other product managers. You will lead product discovery, define clear requirements, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and push products from 0→1 and from 1→scale with urgency and clarity. This is a highly cross-functional and user-centered role—ideal for someone who loves building foundational experiences that make complex work feel effortless.

Responsibilities

  • Own the success of one or more core product areas, focusing on outcomes and real-world impact - not just outputs, timelines, or feature delivery.

  • Define and drive product vision and strategy by synthesizing user needs, workflow complexity, and business priorities into a clear, scalable roadmap.

  • Lead product discovery through user interviews, workflow mapping, usability testing, shadowing, and qualitative/quantitative research.

  • Translate ambiguous, messy problems into clear product requirements, user stories, and intuitive experiences.

  • Build, launch, and iterate on new capabilities from 0→1 and from 1→scale, ensuring fast learning cycles and high-quality execution.

  • Partner cross-functionally with design and engineering to translate product vision into intuitive user experiences that are technically feasible and built to scale.

  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, Operations, and Marketing to ensure strong product adoption, clarity of value, and real customer impact.

  • Set a high bar for execution, usability, and coherence across the platform.


Candidate Qualifications

  • A minimum of 4 years of product management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS, workflow-heavy products, or operationally complex environments.

  • Proven ability to take ambiguous product ideas from concept to launch and from prototype to real-world usage, with thoughtful prioritization of the highest-impact problems.

  • Strong user instincts: You care deeply about how products feel, flow, and fit into people’s daily work and can uncover user needs through strong product discovery practices.

  • Technical fluency: Able to break down how complex systems work under the hood, distill technical needs and constraints, and partner with engineering to make smart tradeoffs.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to clearly articulate product decisions, tradeoffs, and priorities to diverse audiences.

  • Collaborative leader: demonstrated ability to lead across design, engineering, CX, and go-to-market teams to drive clarity, alignment, and momentum.

  • Bias to action: energized by moving fast, testing ideas, learning from feedback, and iterating.

  • Ownership mindset: accountable for outcomes, comfortable operating in low-structure environments, and eager to lead end-to-end.

Why Tennr?

  • Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.

  • Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure

  • Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.

  • Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like-minded, driven individuals in our Hudson Square office 4 days/week

  • Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks.

Benefits

  • Beautiful new office at 345 Hudson Street

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 100% paid employee health benefit options

  • Employer funded 401(k) match

  • Competitive parental leave

jobs.description_html:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

As a member of the Applied Algorithms and Autonomy team, you will contribute to the design and development of machine learning and AI capabilities for True Anomaly. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will support the development of models and pipelines that enable object classification, anomaly detection, and data-driven decision-making. You are curious, driven, and eager to grow — someone who takes ownership of their work and isn't afraid to tackle hard problems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist in the development, training, and evaluation of ML models across a range of mission-relevant tasks
  • Support data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering pipelines
  • Run experiments, track results, and contribute to model evaluation and iteration
  • Write clean, documented, and testable Python code as part of a collaborative engineering team
  • Learn and grow alongside senior engineers, contributing meaningfully from day one

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, machine learning, data science, electrical engineering, or a similar discipline, plus 2-4 years of experience; or a Master's degree in one of these fields with no experience required.
  • Proficiency in Python
  • Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts including supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and model evaluation
  • Exposure to ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX through coursework, research, or personal projects
  • Strong mathematical fundamentals in linear algebra, statistics, and probability
  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment
  • Passion for spaceflight and advancing capabilities related to space domain awareness and space security

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Internship, research, or project experience applying ML to real-world or research datasets
  • Familiarity with classification, regression, clustering, or anomaly detection techniques
  • Experience with version control (Git) and basic software engineering practices
  • Exposure to MLOps concepts such as experiment tracking or model versioning
  • Coursework or project work in deep learning, computer vision, or time-series analysis

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $125,000 - $220,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience. 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work Location— this is a fully onsite role. Candidates must be based in or able to commute to our Denver or Long Beach office daily. 
  • Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.
  • Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite 

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

Software is the central nervous system for True Anomaly's engineering and product thesis. Software bridges the gap between military objectives, theoretical astrodynamics and the human and autonomous control of spacecraft and ground systems in time and space. True Anomaly is seeking a dedicated Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to drive feature development and architectural decisions across our React/TypeScript frontend and Elixir backend, shaping the evolution of our spacecraft modeling, simulation, and ground control software.

This is a high-autonomy, high-accountability role. You'll own entire feature domains from conception to production across the full stack, drive architectural decisions that affect both the frontend experience and backend infrastructure, and set the standard for code quality that junior and mid-level engineers will follow. You won't wait to be assigned work; you'll identify what needs to be done, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. When you see tech debt on either side of the stack, you'll flag it, scope it, and champion the work to address it. When patterns aren't serving us, you'll propose better ones and lead their adoption.

You do not need to have experience building space ground systems or experience in aerospace. You'll have ownership of challenging, greenfield problems and a chance to fundamentally impact the outcome of future conflict (and the future of the company), all while enjoying world-class benefits including platinum healthcare, flexible work hours/location, highly competitive compensation and a generous stock options package.

RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Own and deliver complex features end-to-end across the full stack, from 2D and 3D web-based frontend interfaces through distributed Elixir backend services, from technical design through production deployment and iteration
  • Drive architectural direction across frontend and backend systems, establishing patterns and conventions that scale across the team and codebase, with particular attention to the boundaries and contracts between layers
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks across the stack
  • Set the quality bar through rigorous code review, championing testing practices in both React and Elixir, and writing code that serves as a reference implementation for the team
  • Mentor and elevate junior and mid-level engineers through pairing, design discussions, and constructive code review that teaches, not just approves, helping engineers grow their skills on whichever side of the stack they're less experienced in
  • Collaborate as a technical partner with product, design, QA, space operators, and astrodynamics algorithm engineers, contributing to system-wide architectural decisions with a perspective that spans the full stack
  • Ship efficiently and iteratively, breaking complex cross-stack work into well-scoped increments while maintaining a bias toward completion over perfection
  • Document decisions and patterns, ensuring the team's collective knowledge grows and onboarding becomes easier over time

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE 

  • You see a PR from a junior engineer that implements a feature on the frontend but introduces an inefficient API call pattern; you don't just fix the frontend; you suggest a backend change that solves the problem at its root and explain the tradeoffs
  • You notice the same data transformation happening in both the Elixir backend and the React frontend; you determine the right layer for it, consolidate, and document the decision for the team
  • You're assigned a feature and the requirements are ambiguous; you proactively clarify with product and design, propose a technical approach that accounts for both frontend UX and backend system design, and share it with the team before diving into implementation
  • You see downtime as an opportunity, not a break; you're the kind of engineer who notices a flaky integration between the frontend and a WebSocket endpoint and decides to finally fix both sides
  • You disagree with an architectural decision; you articulate your concerns constructively, propose alternatives with tradeoffs, and commit fully once a decision is made
  • You're thinking beyond your current ticket; you understand how frontend features depend on backend services and vice versa, and you surface risks, coupling issues, or opportunities early

 QUALIFICATIONS 

  • 7+ years of software development experience with meaningful depth across both frontend and backend development
  • Expert-level command of HTML/CSS and modern TypeScript/JavaScript, including nuanced understanding of performance implications and browser internals
  • Deep expertise in modern React, including advanced patterns (compound components, render props, custom hooks architecture), state management strategies, and performance optimization techniques
  • Strong proficiency in Elixir and OTP, including deep understanding of BEAM internals, process architecture, supervision strategies, and fault-tolerant system design
  • Strong testing philosophy and hands-on experience across the stack, including Vitest, React Testing Library, and end-to-end testing on the frontend; ExUnit, property-based testing, and integration testing for distributed systems on the backend; you understand what to test, not just how
  • Proven experience designing and evolving component libraries, design systems, service architectures, and API boundaries Fluency with gRPC, RESTful, and WebSocket-based services, including designing APIs that serve both frontend and backend needs effectively
  • Strong database experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design, query optimization, and understanding of data modeling tradeoffs
  • Track record of working in Git-based workflows with high standards for commit hygiene, PR quality, and collaborative review processes
  • U.S. Citizen and eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar discipline
  • Experience as a technical lead or primary implementor on a product with real users and production constraints, with responsibility spanning both frontend and backend
  • Experience building and shipping complex, data-dense applications with demanding performance requirements (large datasets, real-time updates, complex visualizations) across the full stack
  • Deep experience with Three.js, React Three Fiber, or other web-based 3D libraries, including performance profiling and optimization
  • Deep understanding of OTP including BEAM scheduling, GenServers, run queues, pg, the Actor model, and advanced patterns like dynamic supervisors, registries, and distributed process groups
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, and distributed tracing in production systems (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Experience in UI/UX design collaboration and tools like Figma, able to speak the language of design and advocate for engineering constraints
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills that let you thrive in a culture that values respectful, professional, and constructive conflict

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $180,000 - $265,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience. 

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work Location—This is an onsite role, we are seeking candidates based near Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA. 
  • Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

This is not a research role. It is a building role. You will ship capabilities that engineers, program managers, operators, and business teams use every day to move faster and produce better work.

The scope is broad by design. Your work will range from building connectors between AI models and internal systems, developing custom applications for a specific business workflow, and more. You will own platform-level technical decisions about AI providers, tools, and architectures. You will also help build and deliver AI training and enablement for the company, including office hours, brown bags, and hands-on resources. 

The platform engineering org, reporting to the Chief Security Officer, will work across the enterprise, from engineering and product to marketing and finance.  You will have meaningful autonomy, visibility to executive leadership, and the opportunity to shape how a fast-growing defense technology company operates with AI. 

As a technical leader on the team, you’ll be expected to bring a breadth of cross discipline experience from areas like cloud infrastructure, DevOps, systems design, technical decision making, operations, and working across organizational boundaries to move the needle for customers.  You will use your broad skillset to partner with senior leaders to deliver AI capabilities to the company.  You will mentor other engineers to promote their growth.  You will work through significant ambiguity to establish technical requirements and deliver results for internal stakeholders.

  • Contribute to AI training and enablement programs for the company, including hands-on workshops, office hours, documentation, and shared resources that help teams build real fluency

  • Stay current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape and bring informed recommendations on new models, tools, and capabilities that could accelerate the company

YOUR MISSION

At True Anomaly, we’re building the next generation of space defense. As we scale, the foundational cloud infrastructure that everything else is built on, including how we run compute, connect our environments, and ship software, becomes one of the most important force multipliers in the company. We are investing in platform engineering as a core operating capability, and this role exists to make that investment real.

As a Staff Infrastructure Platform Engineer, you will be one of the first hires building the cloud infrastructure, tooling, and standards that every engineering team across the company depends on. You will design and ship the foundational infrastructure that the rest of the company relies on, including multi-cloud environments, the connectivity between them, and the paved-road patterns for how software gets built, deployed, and operated. Your work will let engineering teams across True Anomaly move faster and more safely.

The scope is broad by design. Your work will range from designing cross-cloud networking between AWS and Azure, to authoring reusable infrastructure-as-code that other teams build on, to establishing CI/CD and deployment standards that scale across the whole enterprise. You will own platform-level technical decisions about cloud architecture, tooling, and build-vs-buy, and you will be the technical anchor for the first infrastructure engineers on the team, leading, coaching, and mentoring them as we grow the function.

The platform engineering org, reporting to the Chief Security Officer, works across the enterprise, from engineering and product to marketing and finance. You will have meaningful autonomy, visibility to executive leadership, and the opportunity to shape how a fast-growing defense technology company builds and operates its infrastructure.

As a technical leader on the team, you’ll be expected to bring a breadth of cross-discipline experience from areas like software engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, systems design, and technical decision-making. You will partner with senior leaders across the organization, exercise cross-organizational influence to align teams on shared standards, and work through significant ambiguity to establish technical requirements and deliver results. You will coach and mentor a team through the delivery of complex technical projects, and set the technical bar for how infrastructure is built at True Anomaly.

* Deep experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including deploying and running production workloads at scale.

* Experience using AI-powered development tools to deliver production code and automate routine work, and the ability to leverage AI as a force multiplier for yourself and your team.

* Ability to exercise cross-organizational influence and to coach and mentor a team through the delivery of complex technical projects.

* Self-directed and comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and the playbook is being written in real time. Able to work through significant ambiguity to define requirements and deliver results.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

YOUR MISSION

Cloud security at True Anomaly isn't about checking compliance boxes—it's about protecting infrastructure that enables space domain awareness and satellite operations. As our Staff Platform Engineer, Security, you'll build security tooling and implement security controls that enable our engineering teams to ship safely on cloud platforms. You'll implement security controls for our multi-cloud environments, working closely with staff engineers on architecture decisions while securing production workloads across Azure and AWS. Strong Azure security expertise is highly valued; deep AWS knowledge will be increasingly critical as our cloud footprint evolves. Working as part of the Platform Security team, you'll have impact within the security team and partner engineering teams.

This is a hands-on role where you'll write production code daily, owning security projects within the cloud domain. You'll implement cloud security solutions and build tooling to enforce security controls. You'll solve complex security problems, taking ownership of projects from design through implementation with guidance on architecture and strategic direction. You'll be working in an AI-native environment where leveraging AI to accelerate your impact is expected.

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build security tooling, automation, and services for cloud security—implementing secure patterns that engineering teams can adopt
  • Implement security best practices and provide technical input on cloud security, IAM architecture, network security, and infrastructure-as-code
  • Implement and maintain security controls that strengthen the security posture of our cloud environments across Azure and AWS
  • Implement secure-by-default cloud infrastructure including IAM, network architecture (VPCs, subnets, NACLs, Security Groups, Transit Gateways), data protection, encryption, and security monitoring
  • Operate and maintain PKI infrastructure for cloud environments—including private CA hierarchies (AWS Private CA, AD CS), certificate lifecycle management, mTLS for service-to-service authentication, and load balancer certificate management
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault as the central secrets management platform—including Vault PKI engine, dynamic secrets, authentication methods, and policy management. You'll build and maintain this infrastructure, not just configure managed services
  • Partner with Kubernetes Security Engineer to implement unified PKI infrastructure across cloud and container environments, providing input on design decisions. Collaborate on K8s IAM integration, network policies, node security, and CSI driver security
  • Design and troubleshoot multi-account and multi-VPC network topologies—diagnosing connectivity issues and security group misconfigurations across cloud environments
  • Build automation and tooling to enforce security policies, detect misconfigurations, and respond to threats in cloud environments
  • Execute cloud security posture management (CSPM), threat detection, and incident response projects
  • Implement security improvements to infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes
  • Partner with engineering teams to implement secure cloud architectures for new capabilities and workloads
  • Build security testing tools, CLI utilities, and dashboards to continuously validate security controls
  • Solve complex security challenges in multi-cloud environments
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate development and automate security workflows

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain security clearance
  • 10+ years of experience in technical roles, including securing production cloud environments at scale, with strong understanding of cloud security models, attack patterns, and defensive strategies across Azure and AWS
  • Strong software development skills in Python (preferred) and/or Go with experience building security tooling and automation
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals: comfortable with data structures, algorithms, API design, debugging production systems, and working across multiple languages
  • Strong Terraform skills including module design and infrastructure-as-code security best practices
  • Experience building security tooling or automation used by engineering teams
  • Strong experience with cloud networking and troubleshooting across AWS and Azure: VPCs/VNets, subnets, NACLs/NSGs, Security Groups, Transit Gateways/Virtual WAN, VPC peering, route tables, and VPN/ExpressConnect—you can debug "why can't X talk to Y" across multi-account/multi-subscription network topologies
  • Hands-on experience with cloud security tools (CSPM, CWPP, SIEM) and infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Strong knowledge of IAM, encryption, logging/monitoring, and cloud-native security patterns
  • DevSecOps mindset with experience embedding security into development and operations workflows
  • Proven ability to assess risk, prioritize work, and execute complex security projects
  • Track record of solving complex technical problems
  • Comfortable diving into unfamiliar codebases and leveraging AI to bridge knowledge gaps
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong PKI knowledge with hands-on experience working with certificate infrastructure—including certificate lifecycle management, mTLS implementation, certificate-based authentication, and X.509/TLS troubleshooting
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault in production—including Vault PKI, dynamic secrets engines, and authentication methods. Experience integrating Vault with Kubernetes, AWS, and Azure auth methods is a plus

 

 

WORK ENVIRONMENT 

  • Fast-paced, mission-critical environment supporting national security space operations 
  • Requires coordination across distributed teams including spacecraft engineers, ground operations, software developers, and government partners 
  • May require participation in on-call rotation for security incident response and mission-critical system support 
     
  • Occasional travel to government sites, launch facilities, or partner locations may be required 

 

COMPENSATION

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.
