YOUR MISSION

Software is the central nervous system for True Anomaly's engineering and product thesis. Software bridges the gap between military objectives, theoretical astrodynamics and the human and autonomous control of spacecraft and ground systems in time and space. True Anomaly is seeking an exceptional Staff Full Stack Software Engineer to lead the technical direction and evolution of our spacecraft modeling, simulation, and distributed ground control platform across the entire stack.

This is a high-impact, strategic leadership role. You'll define and drive the technical roadmap spanning frontend and backend systems, lead cross-functional initiatives that bridge engineering, product, and operations, and establish the architectural foundations that will scale our platform for years to come. You'll identify strategic technical investments, champion them across the organization, and lead their execution. You won't just build features; you'll shape the product direction, influence company objectives, and mentor the engineers who will build the next generation of our platform. When you see systemic issues affecting velocity, reliability, or quality across the stack, you'll diagnose root causes, build consensus around solutions, and drive organizational change to address them.

You do not need to have experience building space ground systems or experience in aerospace. You'll lead high-priority, greenfield initiatives with strategic importance to the company and a chance to fundamentally impact the outcome of future conflict (and the future of the company), all while enjoying world-class benefits including platinum healthcare, flexible work hours/location, highly competitive compensation and a generous stock options package. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Lead and deliver large-scale, cross-functional initiatives that span the entire stack, aligning frontend experience, backend infrastructure, and system architecture with strategic company objectives, from technical vision through production deployment and long-term evolution
  • Define and drive the full-stack technical roadmap and architectural strategy, establishing patterns, frameworks, and systems that enable the entire engineering organization to move faster across both React/TypeScript and Elixir codebases
  • Serve as the primary technical decision-maker for cross-stack architecture, evaluating and adopting new technologies, defining the boundaries and contracts between frontend and backend systems, and establishing engineering standards that balance innovation with maintainability
  • Proactively identify systemic technical debt, scalability challenges, and architectural limitations across the stack, then build business cases, secure buy-in, and lead multi-quarter initiatives to address them
  • Elevate the engineering organization through technical mentorship, establishing best practices, leading design reviews, and developing the skills of senior, mid-level, and junior engineers across both frontend and backend disciplines
  • Partner with executive leadership, product, design, space operations, and astrodynamics teams as a key technical stakeholder, influencing product strategy and company direction with a perspective that encompasses the entire technical surface
  • Drive engineering efficiency and excellence by establishing metrics, tooling, and processes that improve code quality, system reliability, deployment velocity, and developer experience across the stack
  • Build and maintain technical documentation, architectural decision records, and knowledge-sharing systems that scale organizational learning
  • Represent the full-stack engineering perspective in strategic planning, resource allocation, and cross-company technical decisions Identify and develop emerging technical leaders within the team, creating growth pathways and opportunities for engineers to expand their impact across the stack 

 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE 

  • You recognize that the team is repeatedly solving similar problems differently across the frontend and backend; you design and champion unified patterns, drive their adoption across teams, and measure their impact on velocity and reliability
  • You identify a fundamental mismatch between the frontend data model and the backend service architecture before it becomes a scaling crisis; you build a compelling case with data, present it to leadership, secure a quarter of engineering time, and lead a coordinated migration across both layers
  • You're involved in early product strategy discussions, not just implementation; you're shaping what we build by contributing technical insights about feasibility, risk, and opportunity that account for the full system
  • A critical production issue arises that spans the frontend and backend; you quickly establish incident command, coordinate the response across teams and layers, drive it to resolution, and lead the post-mortem that prevents recurrence 
  • You see a pattern of frontend and backend engineers making architectural decisions in isolation from each other; you establish a lightweight cross-stack review process that improves decisions while respecting team autonomy
  • You're asked about the 6-month technical roadmap and can articulate not just what's being built across the stack, but why it matters, what success looks like, what the risks are, and what alternatives were considered Junior and mid-level engineers come to you not because they're stuck on a problem, but because they want to validate their architectural thinking; and you help them grow as technical decision-makers who think beyond their layer of the stack
  • You notice the team is spending significant time on a class of integration bugs between the frontend and backend; you trace it to a root architectural cause, propose a fundamental rework of the contract between layers, and lead its implementation You disagree with a strategic product or technical decision being made at the executive level; you present a well-researched alternative with clear tradeoffs and business impact, influencing the final direction 

 QUALIFICATIONS 

  • 12+ years of software development experience, with demonstrated expertise across both frontend and backend development
  • Expert-level mastery of HTML/CSS and modern TypeScript/JavaScript, including deep understanding of performance optimization, browser internals, memory management, and runtime characteristics
  • Deep expertise in modern React and the broader frontend ecosystem, including architectural patterns for large-scale applications, advanced state management, performance profiling and optimization, and emerging frontend technologies
  • Expert-level mastery of Elixir and OTP, including deep understanding of BEAM internals, scheduling, memory management, garbage collection, process architecture, and runtime characteristics at scale
  • Deep expertise in designing, building, and evolving large-scale distributed systems, including architectural patterns for fault tolerance, consistency, availability, clustering, and horizontal scalability
  • Proven track record of establishing comprehensive testing strategies across the full stack, including unit, integration, property-based, and end-to-end, including championing testing culture and tooling adoption 
  • Extensive experience designing, building, and evolving component libraries, design systems, service architectures, and internal infrastructure that serve multiple teams and products
  • Expert-level understanding of distributed systems integration patterns including gRPC, REST, WebSockets, and GraphQL, with experience defining API contracts and influencing architecture decisions across the stack
  • History of leading technical initiatives in Git-based workflows, establishing code review standards, and fostering collaborative engineering culture
  • U.S. Citizen and eligible for DoD Secret or TS/SCI clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar discipline
  • Proven experience as a technical lead, staff engineer, or principal engineer on production systems with significant user bases and business-critical requirements, with responsibility spanning multiple layers of the stack 
  • Track record of leading large-scale migrations, architectural overhauls, or platform rewrites across frontend and backend systems while maintaining product velocity and system reliability
  • Deep expertise building and optimizing complex, data-intensive applications with demanding performance requirements (real-time processing, large-scale datasets, complex visualizations, distributed systems) across the full stack Advanced proficiency with Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, or other web-based 3D rendering technologies, including low-level performance optimization and shader programming
  • Deep mastery of OTP including BEAM scheduling, GenServers, run queues, pg, the Actor model, dynamic supervisors, registries, distributed process groups, and custom OTP behaviours, with experience pushing the boundaries of the runtime
  • Advanced experience with database design and optimization at scale, including PostgreSQL internals, replication strategies, and data modeling for distributed systems Extensive experience with monitoring, observability, and distributed tracing across the full stack, including designing observability strategies and incident response frameworks
  • Experience bridging engineering and design through deep UI/UX collaboration, design systems development, and tools like Figma, able to influence design decisions with technical constraints and possibilities
  • Experience in highly regulated industries (aerospace, defense, healthcare, finance) with understanding of compliance, security, and operational constraints
  • Published technical writing, open source contributions, or conference speaking that demonstrates thought leadership
  • Exceptional communication skills that enable you to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels of the organization

COMPENSATION

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Experiences
jobs.description_html:
Twin Health 

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. 

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here 

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are building a new interface to health: the Digital Twin.

The Digital Twin is a living, real-time model of each member’s metabolism and behavior—continuously learning from sensors, meals, sleep, movement, labs, and daily choices. It detects patterns, anticipates what’s coming, and guides members toward better health through timely, personalized actions.

To the member, it feels like a single, ever-present guide.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager, AI Experiences to define how members and care teams interact with this intelligence.

You will own the experiences that make AI a core part of how people use Twin—combining conversation, UI, personalized content, insights, and actions into experiences that feel natural, trusted, and useful.

You will own three critical areas:

  • Ask Your Twin (AYT) and its evolution to AYT Everywhere — moving from a destination members go to for chat toward intelligence that is available throughout the Twin experience.
  • Ask Your Agent, our AI Copilot for the Care Team — helping clinicians and care-team members understand what is happening with a member, decide what matters, and take action.
  • AI Experience interaction behaviors and primitives — defining how conversation and AI work across the product, including how insights, charts, recommendations, content, and actions become interactive and conversational.

The challenge isn't simply to get members to chat more. It's to use AI to make Twin meaningfully more effective at changing behavior and improving health outcomes.

Responsibilities 

Own Ask Your Twin (AYT) and its evolution to AYT Everywhere

  • Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for AYT
  • Evolve AYT from a chat destination into an intelligent experience available throughout Twin
  • Define when AI should respond, proactively engage, surface an insight, recommend an action, or get out of the way
  • Drive meaningful improvements in behavior change, engagement, and clinical outcomes

Own Ask Your Agent, the AI Copilot for Twin’s Care Team

  • Define how care-team members use AI to understand what matters about a member, ask questions, explore signals, and determine the right next action
  • Design experiences that reduce cognitive and operational burden while increasing the quality and effectiveness of care

Own AI experience primitives and interaction behaviors across Twin

  • Define how conversation + UI + personalized content + insights + actions work together as one experience
  • Make insights, charts, recommendations, plans, and content conversational—allowing users to ask questions, explore, understand why something matters, and take action
  • Define when the right interaction is chat, voice, traditional UI, proactive guidance, or a combination
  • Create reusable interaction patterns that enable other Twin teams to build consistent AI-native experiences

Define how Twin’s agents behave

  • Establish interaction and conversation patterns that make AI feel natural, personalized, useful, and trustworthy
  • Define proactive vs. reactive behaviors, context and continuity, human/AI handoffs, and escalation
  • Design experiences that work well despite the imperfect and non-deterministic nature of AI

Establish metrics and evaluation systems

  • Measure guidance quality, conversation effectiveness, problem resolution, member trust, and Care Team effectiveness
  • Connect AI experience metrics to behavior change, engagement, and clinical outcomes
  • Combine AI evaluation with product experimentation and real-world user outcomes

Operate at frontier speed

  • Rapidly move from insight → prototype → experiment → production → learning
  • Partner deeply with Design, AI Engineering, Clinical, Data, and Product teams
  • Continuously evaluate emerging capabilities across LLMs, agents, voice, personalization, and multimodal experiences
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications 

  • 8+ years of Product Management experience, including significant ownership of consumer- or user-facing products.
  • Significant recent experience building and shipping AI-native or agentic products used directly by end users.
  • Demonstrated ownership of an AI agent that was central to the user's experience or workflow.
  • Experience defining and measuring the quality of AI interactions using both AI evaluation techniques and product/outcome metrics.
  • Strong understanding of LLM and agent capabilities, limitations, and failure modes.
  • Strong experimentation and analytical skills, including KPI definition and evaluation design.
  • Ability to operate from product vision and strategy through detailed interaction decisions and rapid experimentation.
  • Builder mindset—you move quickly from concept to prototype to shipped experience.

Healthcare experience is valuable but not required. We care more about having built exceptional AI-native experiences that people use, trust, and act on.

Compensation and Benefits 

The compensation range for this position is $205,000 - $240,000 annually. 

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation 
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan
Salary range for US jobs
US Salary Range
$205,000—$240,000 USD

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a twinhealth.com email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health. 

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here 

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own scheduling and the lab experience end to end, and to build the tools that power workforce planning for care team capacity. Much of this work runs through our core clinical operations platform, the system of record for members and the backbone for how our care team operates day to day. This work sits at the center of care delivery — when it works well, members get seen faster and care teams spend their time on patients instead of process.

This role calls for a builder mentality: someone comfortable specifying, prompting, and shipping AI-powered features quickly, then iterating based on real usage. You'll work closely with design, engineering, data science, and clinical stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize solutions that meet real-world operational needs, and ensure strong alignment across teams.

Responsibilities 

  • Own scheduling and the lab experience end to end, including the core clinical operations platform that underpins much of this work, balancing reliability today with a roadmap to modernize it.
  • Build the tools that power workforce planning for care team capacity, partnering closely with the team that owns the underlying supply and demand models.
  • Design and deliver AI-powered features that improve scheduling efficiency, lab turnaround, and staffing decisions, moving fast with strong prompt, versioning, and evaluation practices.
  • Collaborate closely with clinical and operations stakeholders to understand user needs and pain points, and translate them into detailed specs, user stories, and Jira tickets.
  • Lead cross-functional agile teams through all stages of the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch and iteration.
  • Define and track success metrics to measure impact on scheduling efficiency, lab turnaround, staffing utilization, and care quality.
  • Work closely with AI/ML teams to ensure technical solutions are interpretable, clinically safe, and effectively integrated into workflows.
  • Align with leadership and cross-functional partners to ensure product direction supports company strategy and operational goals.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in healthcare technology, operations, or workflow platforms.
  • Experience shipping AI/ML-powered features (LLMs, agents, RAG, personalization), with clear metric lifts.
  • Experience designing and launching products for operational or care-team-facing workflows, including scheduling, staffing, or logistics.
  • Proven ability to build complex workflow tools and AI-integrated features in regulated environments.
  • Comfort with quantitative, model-driven problems such as demand forecasting or capacity/supply modeling.
  • Strong understanding of clinical operations, healthcare delivery models, and the needs of multidisciplinary care teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead agile teams and manage the product development lifecycle end to end.
  • Strategic thinker with excellent execution skills, capable of balancing long-term vision with short-term priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with strong product judgment: comfort with A/B testing, KPI definition, ambiguity, and fast iteration.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience owning or working within an EMR or core clinical operations platform (e.g., Epic, athenahealth) is a strong plus.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits  

The compensation range for this position is $175,000 - $195,000 annually. 

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation 
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan

  • Improve AI/ML systems and services to drive behavior change and sustained metabolic health improvements across our member base.
  • Raise the technical level of the team through code review and design review — this is IC technical leadership, not people management. You will not have direct reports.

  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical decisions beyond your own project.
  • Experience with Voice AI or specialized Language Models (VLMs, multi-modal, etc.) is a plus.

You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.
  • Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.
  • Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.

  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.description_html:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

The Third-Party Risk Management team drives product development excellence across Vanta's EPD organization. This area is responsible for building and improving the tools, practices, and systems that enable product squads to move faster and deliver higher-quality experiences. As Director of Design, you will lead a team of product designers, set the design strategy for the area, and ensure Vanta ships world-class user experiences across your squads.

As a Director of Product Design at Vanta, you will define a net-new experience vision, strategy, and execution for a highly AI-centric workflow builder. You’ll partner cross functionally to align others around your vision and execution, championing your experience strategy to scale your customer impact. You’ll enable Vanta to serve our most complex enterprise use cases while opening up an entirely new class of automation and extensibility across the product.

 
 

What you’ll do as a Director of Design at Vanta:

  • Set the vision and design strategy for Vanta’s Risk product area, helping customers understand, prioritize, and act on risk across their organizations.

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of product designers while fostering a culture of craft, experimentation, accountability, and customer obsession.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Design Systems, and Go-to-Market teams to shape strategy and deliver cohesive customer experiences.

  • Translate complex risk management workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences for security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

  • Define experiences that help customers identify, assess, treat, monitor, communicate, and report on risk.

  • Create simple, connected workflows across risks, assets, vendors, controls, tasks, frameworks, owners, approvals, and organizational hierarchies.

  • Guide the design of enterprise-grade risk registers, dashboards, reporting experiences, and workflows that give customers a clear view of their risk posture.

  • Lead customer-centered discovery and research with risk managers, security leaders, compliance professionals, and other Vanta customers to identify meaningful problems and validate solutions.

  • Establish a high bar for interaction design, visual design, information architecture, accessibility, content, and overall product quality.

  • Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, customer insights, prototypes, and compelling narratives.

  • Develop frameworks and processes that help the Risk design team make effective decisions, move quickly, and maintain consistency across complex product experiences.

  • Partner with the Design Systems team to evolve reusable patterns that support a coherent and scalable Vanta experience.

  • Bring clarity to ambiguous, highly complex problems and help cross-functional teams align around a shared vision of the customer experience.

  • Define and measure the impact of design through customer outcomes, product adoption, usability, efficiency, and business results.

  • Help shape AI-powered experiences that make risk management more proactive, actionable, and accessible while applying sound judgment around trust, transparency, and responsible use of AI.

  • Represent Design in leadership discussions, planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums.

  • Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, mentoring leaders and designers, and strengthening how Vanta approaches product design.

  • Working AI-natively: uses AI tools throughout the design process, and has shipped designs for non-deterministic, AI-powered experiences (chat, agentic modalities, etc).

How to be successful in this role:

  • 10+ years of experience designing digital products, including significant experience leading product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

  • 4+ years of experience managing and developing product designers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

  • Experience setting design direction for a product area and translating company strategy into clear team priorities and outcomes.

  • A track record of designing intuitive workflows for complex, data-rich, or highly configurable products.

  • Strong product thinking and systems thinking, with the ability to understand relationships across interconnected objects, users, workflows, and business processes.

  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering leaders to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver high-quality products.

  • A deep understanding of customer-centered design practices, including qualitative research, journey mapping, prototyping, usability testing, and iterative product development.

  • Strong interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and storytelling skills, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful and high-quality work.

  • Experience designing products in risk management, cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

  • Familiarity with design systems and experience creating scalable patterns that support consistency across a growing product.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executives, cross-functional partners, and customers.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to build trust, encourage diverse perspectives, and bring teams together around a shared vision.

  • A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.

  • Open to using AI to amplify your skills and strengthen your work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

Vanta is hiring for a Head of Design (VP) to lead our design organization — setting direction for a ~40-person team, shaping the next generation of AI-native product experiences, and building the quality systems that let great design ship at scale.

The Design team at Vanta shapes how security and compliance teams experience Vanta — from a startup founder building their security program for the first time to an enterprise security team managing hundreds of controls. The org spans all areas of Vanta — GRC, Trust, Platform, Self-serve, and AI — and includes product designers, visual designers, design engineering, content designers, and a user researcher, led by experienced design directors. As AI fundamentally changes what products can do and how they get built, this team is at an inflection point: the right leader will define what it means for a design org to be genuinely AI-forward — enabling designers to move faster, ship more, and contribute to product direction and delivery in new ways.

This is the right role for a design leader who leads with AI fluency, brings strong taste and craft across interaction design and visual design, and has the operational instincts to build the systems that make quality a consistent property of the whole org.

What you’ll do as Head of Design at Vanta:

  • Lead a team of ~40 designers and design directors across GRC, Trust, Platform, Self-serve, and AI — setting org-wide direction and enabling each leader to do their best work

  • Lead the team building the next generation of agentic, AI-native product experiences — defining what great design looks like as Vanta’s products are increasingly shaped by AI

  • Establish an AI-native design practice: evolve agentic UX patterns, redesign team workflows around AI tooling, and define how design engineers and designers collaborate in an AI-first environment

  • Bring a strong point of view to design decisions — engaging deeply on interaction design, visual quality, and product direction, and building the trust that allows design decision-making to scale

  • Set a clear, shared standard for design quality across Vanta — spanning visual design, interaction design, and AI-enabled experiences — and build the systems that hold that bar consistently: design system, definitions of done, and launch review frameworks

  • Drive design as a first mover: shape design direction proactively, establishing the taste and systems that set the pace for the product and the org

  • Build strong partnerships with Product and Engineering, establishing shared quality frameworks embedded in how the whole org ships

  • Recruit and grow the team — develop existing leadership, maintain a high bar for AI fluency and design craft across every hire, and close capability gaps as the org evolves

How to be successful in this role:

  • 15+ years of design experience, with 5+ years leading and scaling large design organizations, with director-level reports

  • Deep fluency in interaction design and visual craft — enjoys getting into the weeds, providing precise direction, and holding a high bar for quality across design decisions

  • Deep B2B SaaS experience — understanding the constraints of building for SMB and enterprise customers, complex workflows, multi-user products, and platform-level design challenges

  • Org-level AI fluency: has built AI tooling, workflows, and cultural adoption into a design team’s practice, enabling teams to ship more and move faster; has a clear point of view on how AI changes design roles and team structure

  • Proven track record building quality systems: design system ownership, definitions of done, launch review processes, and quality frameworks built in partnership with Product and Engineering

  • Has led design through a company inflection point — navigates ambiguity, adapts the org, and maintains quality and momentum when the business is changing fast

  • Strong XFN leadership — trusted by product and engineering counterparts, navigates fast-moving and opinionated exec environments, and drives alignment on shared outcomes

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

  • Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how your team operates and delivers results.

  • Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

How to be successful in this role:

  • Experience collaborating closely with front-end engineers to ensure design-to-code fidelity and maintain a shared vocabulary between design and implementation

  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma — including variants, auto-layout, and design tokens — with experience publishing and managing shared libraries at scale across a product organization

  • Lead the strategy, evolution, and execution of Vanta's design system, ensuring it scales with the needs of a rapidly growing product organization

  • Partner with product designers and engineers across all product teams to define, document, and ship new components, patterns, and guidelines

jobs.description_html:
About the Role

We are seeking a Technical Recruiter to lead full-cycle recruiting for production, engineering, and other positions as needed. This role will source, screen, and coordinate candidates through the hiring process, manage day-to-day administration of our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and support onboarding logistics to ensure a smooth transition for new hires.

Key Responsibilities

Recruiting & Sourcing

  • Support full-cycle recruiting for production, engineering, and other roles (e.g., systems engineers, software/hardware engineers, program managers, cleared personnel, and other roles)
  • Manage requisition workload across multiple open roles simultaneously, prioritizing based on business needs and urgency
  • Source passive and active candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, niche technical/defense job boards, industry associations, veteran networks, and referrals
  • Screen resumes and conduct initial phone/video interviews to assess technical qualifications and cultural fit
  • Partner with hiring managers to gain a clear understanding of technical requirements and must-have qualifications for each role
  • Coordinate interview panels, assessments, and debriefs with hiring teams
  • Support hiring for cleared positions and understand basic requirements around security clearances (e.g., Secret, Top Secret, TS/SCI) and eligibility requirements
  • Develop sourcing strategies and maintain candidate pipelines to support current and future hiring needs

ATS & Process Management

  • Manage day-to-day administration of the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), including job requisition setup, workflow configuration, and data integrity, keeping leadership informed of any process or workflow changes
  • Ensure accurate and timely candidate status updates, dispositioning, and pipeline tracking within the ATS
  • Generate and analyze recruiting metrics/reports from the ATS (time-to-fill, source of hire, pipeline conversion, etc.) for leadership review
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows, templates, and processes, and propose changes for approval
  • Maintain compliance-related documentation within the ATS (EEO/AAP data, OFCCP requirements, etc.)

Candidate Experience & Onboarding Coordination

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring process, ensuring timely and professional communication
  • Coordinate interview scheduling logistics across multiple stakeholders and time zones
  • Assist in the offer process, including background checks, and other pre-employment requirements
  • Coordinate onboarding logistics for new hires and first-day preparation
  • Continuously recommend improvements to the candidate journey to reflect a positive, professional experience
  • Provide clear timeline expectations and feedback to candidates at each stage

Additional Support

  • Represent the company at technical conferences, defense industry events, career fairs, and veteran hiring initiatives
  • Track and report on recruiting KPIs and provide regular pipeline updates 
  • Keep leadership informed of pipeline status, candidate feedback, and any risks or roadblocks throughout the hiring process

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, talent acquisition, or HR (technical/engineering or defense industry experience a plus, not required)
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Exposure to or hands-on experience with an ATS (e.g., Greenhouse, iCIMS, Workday or similar)
  • Strong organizational and communication skills; comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

  • Experience recruiting for or working within government contractors, defense, or aerospace industries
  • PHR/SHRM-CP or similar HR certification (or actively pursuing)

Vatn Systems is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description_html:
About Wraithwatch

Wraithwatch was founded by alumni from SpaceX, Palantir, and Anduril to build the next generation of AI-powered cyber defense systems for the United States and its allies. We are deployed today to customers spanning the federal government, aerospace, defense, manufacturing, and emerging technology. Our core product is a continuously adaptive cyber defense platform utilizing generative artificial intelligence agents to autonomously model and construct a digital twin of an organization's entire IT and cybersecurity environment and analyze it for weaknesses, misconfigurations, and chains of possible attack.

We currently operate numerous live federal deployments with more coming online this year. Each one is a distinct environment with its own infrastructure, compliance requirements, and operational constraints. We need someone to make all of them run reliably at the same time.

The Role

You are responsible for the infrastructure that keeps Wraithwatch running in production across our federal and commercial deployments.

You will build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, monitoring, and operational tooling that let a small team ship software reliably across all of these environments without things falling apart. When something breaks at 2am in a production federal environment, you're the person who gets it back up. When we need to roll a release across 20 deployments in a week, you're the person who makes that possible without manual SSH sessions into each one.

This is not a role where you're managing infrastructure for a single product in a single cloud account. You're building the deployment and operations backbone for a company that is scaling fast across highly constrained federal and Fortune 500 environments, and every shortcut you skip today becomes a fire you fight next month.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines that reliably ship software across 20+ federal environments in parallel.

  • Own the operational health of all production deployments — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and post-mortems.

  • Design infrastructure that accounts for the reality of federal environments: air-gapped networks, strict compliance requirements, variable network topologies, and limited access windows.

  • Build tooling that gives the engineering team visibility into the state of every deployment without requiring manual inspection.

  • Automate everything that can be automated. We cannot scale to hundreds of environments with manual processes.

  • Work with the product engineering team to ensure new features are deployable across all environments without environment-specific hacks.

  • Manage and improve cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and on-prem deployments depending on customer requirements.

  • Participate in on-call rotations for production environments.

Qualifications

Basic:

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering

  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and configuration management (Ansible, Salt, or similar)

  • Deep Linux systems knowledge — you should be comfortable debugging at the OS level, not just the application level

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for complex multi-environment deployments

  • Proficiency with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred)

  • Comfortable working in highly constrained or regulated environments where you can't just spin up whatever you want

  • Willingness to work extended hours when production issues demand it — we are a seed-stage startup with federal customers who do not tolerate downtime

Preferred:

  • Experience deploying software into federal, DoD, or IC environments

  • Familiarity with FedRAMP, STIG compliance, or ATO processes

  • Experience with air-gapped or disconnected network deployments

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance

  • Experience operating infrastructure at scale across many isolated environments simultaneously

  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, or similar)

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer, Care Access Network
jobs.description_html:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

 

Your Impact on our Mission

At Zocdoc, we are building products that help people access care more easily and help partners deliver better scheduling experiences at scale. As a Lead Product Designer on Care Access Network, you will shape partner-facing experiences that help healthcare organizations understand what is possible with Zocdoc and imagine new ways we can work together. You will bring product design, storytelling, and rapid prototyping together to create compelling visions of future partnership opportunities across dashboards, workflows, reporting, concepts, and tailored experiences.

This is a lead-level individual contributor role for a designer who can move fluidly between strategy, craft, systems thinking, and hands-on making. You will work in a highly consultative environment, using design as a superpower to help prospective and existing partners see around corners, align on opportunity, and build confidence in where the business relationship can go next. You will also help define how design works in a more AI-native product development model, using modern tools and working prototypes to accelerate learning and increase leverage.

 

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • Influential with cross-functional partners through strong storytelling, clear artifacts, and a high degree of ownership.
  • Personally motivated by turning ambiguous opportunities into clear, compelling product direction across multiple surfaces and stakeholders.
  • Energized by working with many different partner contexts and translating business needs into persuasive product stories, prototypes, and concepts.
  • Excited to pair strong product design craft with rapid prototyping, especially when early concepts help clients and internal teams see the art of the possible.
  • Comfortable operating in consultative, commercial, or pitch-oriented environments where design helps move conversations forward and opens the door to future partnership opportunities.
  • Curious about AI-native product development and eager to use emerging tools to increase speed and quality without lowering the craft bar.

 

Your day to day is…

  • Leading end-to-end design across Care Access Network partner experiences, including dashboards, workflows, reporting, and supporting surfaces that help partners and developers understand performance and opportunity.
  • Creating rapid prototypes that explore new scheduling experiences, partnership concepts, and future-facing ideas that help strategic partners and internal teams learn quickly.
  • Developing polished concepts and tailored design narratives that reflect partner brands, business goals, and operational realities to support product strategy and commercial conversations.
  • Using design to help prospective and existing partners imagine the future of a deeper relationship with Zocdoc, including new ways our platform can support their growth.
  • Shaping visually rich reporting and storytelling experiences that make trends, progress, and next steps easier for partners to understand and act on.
  • Contributing to new partner-facing experiences tied to emerging initiatives, including exploratory concepts, landing-page-adjacent surfaces, and flows that help communicate the value of our evolving platform.
  • Using prototypes, systems thinking, and strong communication to align Product, Engineering, Business Development, and go-to-market partners around a shared direction.
  • Mentoring other designers and helping raise the quality and effectiveness of design across multiple workstreams.

 

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • Meaningful experience leading end-to-end product design for complex or ambiguous problem spaces, ideally across B2B products, platforms, service environments, or consultative client engagements.
  • A strong consultative mindset, with experience working across multiple companies, clients, or partner stakeholders and using design to support strategic conversations.
  • Strong visual, interaction, and systems design craft, with the ability to move between polished execution and exploratory concepting.
  • A track record of using prototypes and artifacts to clarify product vision, influence roadmaps, and help external or internal stakeholders imagine future possibilities.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, connecting dots across related workstreams, and bringing clarity to complex problems with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring peers and raising the quality bar beyond your own direct work.
  • Curiosity about AI-assisted workflows and openness to working in code-enabled design environments when it helps the team learn or move faster.

 

Benefits:

  • Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location
  • Unlimited Vacation
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
  • Commuter Benefits
  • 401(k) with employer funded match
  • Corporate wellness programs with Headspace and Peloton
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
  • Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
  • Cell phone reimbursement
  • Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks
  • Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
  • Great Place to Work Certified

Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. $160,000—$210,000 USD

About us
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people.  As a Lead Technical Recruiter, you’ll play an essential role in our company’s growth by supporting staffing for our growing Technology teams. Your ability to think outside of the box to identify, attract, and close the nation’s best talent, paired with your passion for creating an efficient and highly personalized candidate experience, will impact our employees and patients for years to come.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • A Senior Operational Partner: You view technical recruiting as a business problem to solve. You love sitting down with hiring teams to analyze funnel conversion, eliminate interview bottlenecks, and optimize the end-to-end hiring process.
  • A Leader by Example: You take pride in demonstrating recruiting excellence. Peers look to you for advice on stakeholder management, candidate closing mechanics, and complex pipeline problem-solving.
  • A High-Velocity Problem Solver: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment where you operate with high autonomy. You welcome ambiguity and proactively create order out of complex hiring demands.
  • Passionate About Technical Talent & Metrics: You understand technical talent markets, role profiles, leveling, and candidate motivations. You use data to tell stories, manage pipelines, and influence hiring decisions.
  • Grounded in Ownership and Humility: You hold yourself to an exceptionally high standard, operate with low ego, and treat candidates, peers, and executive stakeholders with equal respect and dignity.

Your day to day is…

  • Operationalizing Technical Hiring: Partnering closely with engineering and technology leaders, hiring managers, and recruiting partners to audit and optimize recruitment workflows, ensuring interview loops are fast, structured, and friction-free.
  • Senior Stakeholder Advisory: Acting as a trusted consultant to technology leadership—providing market intelligence, setting realistic pipeline expectations, and using data to solve hiring bottlenecks before they impact product and engineering goals.
  • Executing High-Impact Searches: Directly owning end-to-end recruitment for critical positions across all levels, including senior individual contributors and leadership roles from Manager through Director.
  • Mentorship & Process Rigor: Coaching and uplifting peers on the recruiting team. You will model best practices for structured interviewing, candidate evaluation, and ATS hygiene.
  • Funnel Analytics & Pipeline Health: Leveraging recruiting metrics—such as pass-through rates, time-in-stage, and offer acceptance rates—to track pipeline health, forecast hiring output, and deliver clear reporting to technology leadership.
  • Building Inclusive Pipelines: Proactively sourcing and building diverse talent slates, ensuring equal access and an exceptional, personalized candidate experience at every step.

You’ll be successful in the role if you have…

  • 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a heavy focus on in-house technical recruiting across software engineering, infrastructure, data, security, product, or technology leadership.
  • Proven Operational Impact: A track record of identifying inefficiencies in technical hiring processes and implementing solutions that improved speed, quality, or conversion.
  • Executive Presence: Demonstrated ability to build trust, establish credibility, and constructively push back on senior technology leaders and executives.
  • Technical Recruiting Domain Expertise: Deep familiarity with technical roles, leveling, interview processes, candidate motivations, and competitive technology talent markets.
  • Data & ATS Fluency: Expertise using ATS tools such as Greenhouse or Lever and sourcing platforms such as LinkedIn Recruiter or Gem to track funnel metrics and drive data-informed decision-making.
  • High Remote Autonomy: A proven track record of managing competing priorities, maintaining clear communication across distributed teams, and driving results independently in a remote environment.
  • Mentorship Mindset: Experience guiding, training, or mentoring junior and mid-level recruiters to elevate overall team performance.

Your impact on our mission

Our revenue and customer-facing teams are the backbone of our growth and the face of our brand. As the Senior Manager, GTM Recruiting, you will play a pivotal role in leading talent acquisition for our Sales, Customer Experience, and supporting operational functions (including RevOps, Account Management, and Enablement). 

You will act as a strategic advisor and thought partner to our C-Suite and senior revenue leaders, helping translate high-level business goals into precise workforce plans, headcount forecasts, and proactive talent pipelines. In this role, you will lead, mentor, and elevate a team of engaged recruiters, creating a supportive and high-performing culture. By setting and defending an exceptional talent bar, you ensure every new hire directly contributes to revenue growth and an outstanding customer experience.

 

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • A Strategic Executive Partner: You view recruiting as a core business function. You enjoy sitting down with leaders to challenge assumptions, guide talent strategy, and align hiring targets with business revenue goals.
  • A Builder and Talent Architect: You love designing structured, objective hiring practices that raise the bar. You enjoy analyzing team mechanics and thinking through workforce capacity, headcount forecasting, and ideal operating models.
  • A Coach and People Developer: You find genuine joy in mentoring recruiters, fostering a high-trust culture, and driving sustainable growth. You know when to coach, when to give feedback, and how to make tough performance management decisions with empathy and respect.
  • Data-Driven and Process-Oriented: You believe that data creates accountability and drives better strategy. You naturally blend analytical rigor with intuition to optimize pass-through rates, time-to-fill, and candidate velocity across the funnel.
  • Driven by Ownership and Humility: You operate with high autonomy, hold yourself and your team to rigorous standards, and treat every candidate, stakeholder, and peer with dignity and respect.

 

Your day-to-day is…

  • Executive Partnership & Planning: Partnering directly with GTM leaders, RevOps, and Finance to build multi-quarter headcount forecasts, model capacity, and define profiles for revenue-generating and customer-facing teams.
  • Defending the Talent Bar: Building and refining competency-based evaluation frameworks, structured interview kits, and scorecard criteria to ensure every hire - from individual contributor AEs to Director-level leaders - raises team quality.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Coaching, mentoring, and managing a team of full-cycle recruiters. You’ll manage capacity, conduct performance development, and maintain a high-performing, inclusive team culture.
  • Operational Strategy & Model Optimization: Continually evaluating operational efficiency and recruiter workflows. You will assess when and how to evolve our team structure (such as evaluating a split between specialized sourcers and full-cycle recruiters) as hiring volume dictates.
  • Leadership Search Oversight: Guiding experienced recruiters on the team as they run high-visibility leadership searches (Manager through Senior Director levels) across Sales and CX, while serving as the primary liaison when partnering with external agency partners.
  • Data & Funnel Analytics: Tracking, analyzing, and presenting key recruitment metrics (pipeline velocity, conversion rates, source mix, and offer acceptance) to executive leadership to highlight successes and proactively eliminate bottlenecks.
 

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • Urgency & Bias for Action: You understand the operational impact of open sales quotas and delayed customer support ramps; you move intentionally, strategically, and quickly.
  • 8+ years of total recruiting experience, with a focus on in-house talent acquisition supporting fast-paced Sales, Customer Experience (CX), Customer Success, or Revenue Operations teams.
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience, with a proven history of coaching, mentoring, and developing recruiters.
  • Executive Presence & Influence: Demonstrated experience directly advising, partnering with, and constructively challenging C-Suite and senior executive stakeholders on headcount planning and hiring profiles.
  • Data Literacy & ATS Expertise: Strong track record of leveraging ATS reporting (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever) and recruitment KPIs to forecast output, optimize funnels, and communicate actionable insights to leadership.
  • Sales & CX Domain Acumen: Deep familiarity with sales methodologies, compensation structures (OTEs, quotas, accelerators), and customer experience metrics.
  • Process Infrastructure Rigor: Experience establishing structured, bias-reduced interview processes and candidate scorecard mechanics that raise the hiring bar.

  • Experience translating technical vision into business impact through clear prioritization, investment trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience evaluating or integrating AI tooling into engineering workflows, with practical judgment about privacy, security, quality, and reliability guardrails as AI adoption grows; deep AI-platform specialization is not required.
  • A clear, proactive communicator with a bias to action, humility, and a track record of building inclusive, high-performing, psychologically safe teams while aligning technical and non-technical stakeholders.

jobs.description_html:
Our Mission

Your Impact on our Mission:

Zocdoc is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to make our distributed production systems more observable, reliable, and safe to change. Our platform connects patients, providers, and many interconnected services and integrations, so reliability depends on understanding the full path of a request—not just whether an individual service is running.

You’ll help build the observability foundations, automation, and engineering practices that allow Zocdoc to move quickly without sacrificing safety. You’ll work across cloud infrastructure, microservices, APIs, and integration points in AWS, partnering closely with product engineering teams to identify risks, improve operational visibility, and make the right behavior easier to build and operate.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

  • Passionate about observability and believe that teams can’t reliably operate what they can’t see
  • Experienced in integration-rich environments where APIs, third-party dependencies, asynchronous workflows, and distributed services create complex failure modes
  • Excited by the challenge of helping a fast-moving engineering organization ship quickly while keeping systems safe, diagnosable, and resilient
  • Motivated to turn operational knowledge into reusable platforms, automation, telemetry standards, and paved paths for engineering teams
  • Comfortable leading or supporting incident response, communicating clearly under pressure, and using blameless post-mortems to drive meaningful improvements
  • Curious about how systems behave in production and willing to investigate across application code, infrastructure, networking, and external dependencies
  • Collaborative, pragmatic, and able to build trust with engineers across numerous product development teams
  • Autonomous, individually accountable, and always looking for ways to reduce toil and improve the developer and operator experience

Your day to day is…

  • Designing, building, and operating observability for distributed services and integrations, including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators, and service-level objectives
  • Improving end-to-end visibility across critical patient and provider workflows, including identifying gaps in instrumentation and making dependency health and integration failures easier to understand
  • Creating reliable, repeatable tooling and infrastructure through infrastructure as code, automation, CI/CD, and self-service patterns
  • Partnering with product engineering teams on reliability, scaling, performance, capacity, and failure-mode analysis for services and integrations
  • Helping teams establish actionable alerts and operational ownership so that on-call signals are timely, meaningful, and connected to a clear response path
  • Participating in the on-call rotation and incident response process, including serving as an incident commander when appropriate and driving follow-up work through completion
  • Analyzing and tuning systems, code, cloud resources, and networking for resilience, performance, and efficient operation
  • Strengthening deployment and change-management practices so teams can release frequently with appropriate safeguards, rollback paths, and feedback loops
  • Contributing to platform standards and reusable patterns for containerized workloads, service communication, secrets, routing, and production readiness

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • 5+ years of experience supporting consumer-facing web applications, APIs, or distributed production environments in a Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, or closely related role
  • 2+ years of on-call experience in a 24/7 cloud-based production environment, with a track record of participating in incident response and delivering durable remediation
  • Deep experience operating systems with many integrations, services, dependencies, or external APIs, and a practical understanding of how those relationships affect reliability
  • Demonstrated experience building or improving observability practices, including metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets
  • 2+ years of experience managing and supporting modern cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, along with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, or similar container platforms
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, Ruby, Java, or a comparable language, and the ability to read and troubleshoot application code
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automated delivery practices, such as Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, GitHub Actions, GitOps, or equivalent tools
  • Experience with edge and service networking technologies such as load balancers, reverse proxies, ingress controllers, web application firewalls, routing, rate limiting, or circuit breaking
  • A deep understanding of protocols and foundational networking concepts such as TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, DNS, and NTP
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain operational risk, incident findings, and technical tradeoffs to both engineers and partners
  • Experience working with sensitive data, privacy or compliance requirements, or regulated production environments is a plus, but not required.

  • Flexible work environment based in NYC
  • Unlimited Vacation

  • Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
